How to use Foxit PDF SDK to add Text watermarks into PDF files.

```python
import os
import sys
import site

if sys.version_info.major == 2:
 _PYTHON2_ = True
else:
 _PYTHON2_ = False

if _PYTHON2_:
 site.addsitedir('../../../')
 from FoxitPDFSDKPython2 import *
else:
 from FoxitPDFSDKPython3 import *

sn = ""
key = ""

class SDKLibMgr:
 def __init__(self):
 self.is_initialize_ = False

 def Initialize(self):
 # Initialize library
 error_code = Library.Initialize(sn, key)
 if error_code != e_ErrSuccess:
 print("Library Initialize Error: {}".format(error_code))
 return False
 self.is_initialize_ = True
 return True

 def Release(self):
 if self.is_initialize_:
 Library.Release()

def AddTextWatermark(doc, page):
 settings = WatermarkSettings()
 settings.flags = WatermarkSettings.e_FlagASPageContents | WatermarkSettings.e_FlagOnTop
 settings.offset_x = 0
 settings.offset_y = 0
 settings.opacity = 90
 settings.position = e_PosTopRight
 settings.rotation = -45.0
 settings.scale_x = 1.0
 settings.scale_y = 1.0

 text_properties = WatermarkTextProperties()
 text_properties.alignment = e_AlignmentCenter
 text_properties.color = 0xF68C21
 text_properties.font_style = WatermarkTextProperties.e_FontStyleNormal
 text_properties.line_space = 1
 text_properties.font_size = 12.0
 text_properties.font = Font(Font.e_StdIDTimesB)

 watermark = Watermark(doc, "Foxit PDF SDK\nwww.foxitsoftware.com",
 text_properties, settings)
 watermark.InsertToPage(page)

def main():
 err_ret = 0

 if not os.path.exists(output_directory):
 os.makedirs(output_directory)

 try:

 input_file = "AboutFoxit.pdf"
 output_file = "watermark_add.pdf"

 doc = PDFDoc(input_file)
 error_code = doc.Load("")
 if error_code != e_ErrSuccess:
 print("The Doc [{}] Error: {}\n".format(input_file, error_code))
 return 1

 page_count = doc.GetPageCount()
 for i in range(0, page_count):
 page = doc.GetPage(i)
 page.StartParse(PDFPage.e_ParsePageNormal, None, False)
 AddTextWatermark(doc, page)
 doc.SaveAs(output_file, PDFDoc.e_SaveFlagNoOriginal)
 print("Add watermarks to PDF file.")

 except Exception as ex:
 print(ex.GetMessage())
 err_ret = 1

 return err_ret

if __name__ == '__main__':
 libmgr = SDKLibMgr()
 if libmgr.Initialize():
 main()

 libmgr.Release()
```

How to use Foxit PDF SDK to add, sign and verify PDF document using default.

```python
import os
import sys
import site
import time
import hashlib
from OpenSSL import crypto

if sys.version_info.major == 2:
 _PYTHON2_ = True
else:
 _PYTHON2_ = False

if _PYTHON2_:
 site.addsitedir('../../../')
 from FoxitPDFSDKPython2 import *
else:
 from FoxitPDFSDKPython3 import *

sn = ""
key = ""

class SDKLibMgr:
 def __init__(self):
 self.is_initialize_ = False
 def Initialize(self):
 # Initialize library
 error_code = Library.Initialize(sn, key)
 if error_code != e_ErrSuccess:
 return False
 self.is_initialize_ = True
 return True
 def Release(self):
 if self.is_initialize_:
 Library.Release()

def GetLocalDateTime():
 datetime = DateTime()
 localtime = time.localtime(time.time())
 datetime.year = localtime.tm_year
 datetime.month = localtime.tm_mon
 datetime.day = localtime.tm_mday
 datetime.hour = localtime.tm_hour
 datetime.minute = localtime.tm_min
 datetime.second = localtime.tm_sec

 offset = time.timezone if time.localtime().tm_isdst == 0 else time.altzone
 datetime.utc_hour_offset = int(offset / 60 / 60 * -1)
 datetime.utc_minute_offset = int((abs(offset) % 3600) / 60)
 return datetime

def AddSiganture(pdf_page, sub_filter):
 page_height = pdf_page.GetHeight()
 page_width = pdf_page.GetWidth()
 new_sig_rect = RectF(0, float(page_height * 0.9), float(page_width * 0.4),page_height)
 # Add a new signature to page.
 new_sig = pdf_page.AddSignature(new_sig_rect)
 if new_sig.IsEmpty(): return Signature()
 # Set values for the new signature.
 new_sig.SetKeyValue(Signature.e_KeyNameSigner, "Foxit PDF SDK")
 new_value = "As a sample for subfilter \"{}\"".format(sub_filter)
 new_sig.SetKeyValue(Signature.e_KeyNameReason, new_value)
 new_sig.SetKeyValue(Signature.e_KeyNameContactInfo,"support@foxitsoftware.com")
 new_sig.SetKeyValue(Signature.e_KeyNameDN, "CN=CN,MAIL=MAIL@MAIL.COM")
 new_sig.SetKeyValue(Signature.e_KeyNameLocation, "Fuzhou, China")
 new_value = "As a sample for subfilter \"{}\"".format(sub_filter)
 new_sig.SetKeyValue(Signature.e_KeyNameText, new_value)
 sign_time = GetLocalDateTime()
 new_sig.SetSignTime(sign_time)
 image_file_path = "FoxitLogo.jpg"
 image = Image(image_file_path)
 new_sig.SetImage(image, 0)
 # Set appearance flags to decide which content would be used in appearance.
 ap_flags = Signature.e_APFlagLabel | Signature.e_APFlagSigner | \
 Signature.e_APFlagReason | Signature.e_APFlagDN | \
 Signature.e_APFlagLocation | Signature.e_APFlagText | \
 Signature.e_APFlagSigningTime | Signature.e_APFlagBitmap
 new_sig.SetAppearanceFlags(ap_flags)

 return new_sig

def AdobePPKLiteSignature(pdf_doc):
 filter = "Adobe.PPKLite"
 sub_filter = "adbe.pkcs7.detached"

 pdf_page = pdf_doc.GetPage(0)
 # Add a new signature to first page.
 new_signature = AddSiganture(pdf_page, sub_filter)
 # Set filter and subfilter for the new signature.
 new_signature.SetFilter(filter)
 new_signature.SetSubFilter(sub_filter)

 # Sign the new signature.
 signed_pdf_path = "signed_newsignature_default_handle.pdf"

 cert_file_path = "foxit_all.pfx"
 cert_file_password = "123456"
 # Cert file path will be passed back to application through callback function FSSignatureCallback.Sign().
 # In this demo, the cert file path will be used for signing in callback function FSSignatureCallback.Sign().
 new_signature.StartSign(cert_file_path, cert_file_password,Signature.e_DigestSHA1, signed_pdf_path)
 # Open the signed document and verify the newly added signature (which is the last one).
 signed_pdf_doc = PDFDoc(signed_pdf_path)
 error_code = signed_pdf_doc.Load("")
 if e_ErrSuccess != error_code:
 return

 # Get the last signature which is just added and signed.
 sig_count = signed_pdf_doc.GetSignatureCount()
 signed_signature = signed_pdf_doc.GetSignature(sig_count - 1)
 # Verify the intergrity of signature.
 signed_signature.StartVerify("", None)

def main():
 err_ret = 0

 try:
 input_file = "AboutFoxit.pdf"
 pdf_doc = PDFDoc(input_file)
 pdf_doc.StartLoad("", False, None)
 AdobePPKLiteSignature(pdf_doc)
 except Exception as ex:
 print(ex.GetMessage())
 err_ret = 1

 return err_ret

if __name__ == '__main__':
 libmgr = SDKLibMgr()
 if libmgr.Initialize():
 main()

 libmgr.Release()

```

how to Verify pdf before convert
import os
import sys
import site
if sys.version_info.major == 2:
_PYTHON2_ = True
else:
_PYTHON2_ = False
if _PYTHON2_:
#replace with the python2 lib path
site.addsitedir(‘../../../’)
from FoxitPDFSDKPython2 import *
else:
from FoxitPDFSDKPython3 import *
sn = " "
key = " "

class SDKLibMgr:

 def __init__(self):
 self.is_initialize_ = False

 def Initialize(self):
 # Initialize library
 error_code = Library.Initialize(sn, key)

 self.is_initialize_ = True
 return True

 def Release(self):
 if self.is_initialize_:
 Library.Release()
def OutputPDFAHitData(result_info, output_txt_path):
 text_doc = TextDoc(output_txt_path, "wb+")

 hit_data_count = result_info.GetHitDataCount()
 temp_string = "== Hit Data, count:{:d} ==\r\n".format(hit_data_count)

 text_doc.Write(temp_string)
 for i in range(0, hit_data_count):
 hit_data = result_info.GetHitData(i)
 temp_string = "Triggered count:{:d}\r\n".format(hit_data.triggered_count)

 text_doc.Write(temp_string)

 text_doc.Write("Name:")
 text_doc.Write(hit_data.name)
 text_doc.Write("\r\n")

 text_doc.Write("Comment:")
 text_doc.Write(hit_data.comment)
 text_doc.Write("\r\n")

 text_doc.Write("Trigger value:")
 trigger_value_count = hit_data.trigger_values.GetSize()
 if trigger_value_count < 1:
 text_doc.Write("\r\n")
 else:
 for z in range(0, trigger_value_count):
 text_doc.Write("\t")
 text_doc.Write(hit_data.trigger_values.GetAt(z))
 text_doc.Write("\r\n")

 temp_string = "Check severity:{:d}\r\nPage index:{:d}\r\n".format(hit_data.severity, hit_data.page_index)
 text_doc.Write(temp_string)
 text_doc.Write("\r\n")

 class MyComplianceProgressCallback(ProgressCallback):

 def __init__(self, *args):
 if _PYTHON2_:
 super(MyComplianceProgressCallback, self).__init__()
 else:
 super().__init__()

 self.text_doc = TextDoc(args[0], "wb+")

 def __del__(self):
 self.__disown__()

 def Release(self):
 pass

 def UpdateCurrentStateData(self, *args):
 current_rate = args[0]
 current_state_string = args[1]
 print("Current rate:{}".format(current_rate))

 temp_string = "Current rate:{}, state str:".format(current_rate)

 self.text_doc.Write(temp_string)
 self.text_doc.Write(current_state_string)
 self.text_doc.Write("\r\n")

def main():
 # Initialize compliance engine.
 error_code = ComplianceEngine.Initialize(compliance_resource_folder_path, compliance_engine_unlockcode)
 if error_code != e_ErrSuccess:
 pdfa_compliance = PDFACompliance()
 verify_progress_callback = MyComplianceProgressCallback("0_pdfacompliance_verify_before_convert_progressdata.txt")
 verify_result_info = pdfa_compliance.Verify(
 PDFACompliance.e_VersionPDFA1a, input_file, 0, -1,
 verify_progress_callback)
 OutputPDFAHitData( verify_result_info, "0_pdfacompliance_verify_before_convert_hitdata.txt")

 # Release compliance engine.
 ComplianceEngine.Release()

if __name__ == '__main__':
 libmgr = SDKLibMgr()
 if libmgr.Initialize():
 main()

 libmgr.Release()

how to add caret annotation
import os
import sys
import time
import math
import site
import wave
from uuid import *

if sys.version_info.major == 2:
_PYTHON2_ = True
else:
_PYTHON2_ = False
if _PYTHON2_:
#replace with the python2 lib path
site.addsitedir(‘../../../’)
from FoxitPDFSDKPython2 import *
else:
from FoxitPDFSDKPython3 import *
sn = " "
key = " "

class SDKLibMgr:

 def __init__(self):
 self.is_initialize_ = False

 def Initialize(self):
 # Initialize library
 error_code = Library.Initialize(sn, key)

 self.is_initialize_ = True
 return True

 def Release(self):
 if self.is_initialize_:
 Library.Release()

def GetLocalDateTime():
 datetime = DateTime()
 localtime = time.localtime(time.time())
 datetime.year = localtime.tm_year
 datetime.month = localtime.tm_mon
 datetime.day = localtime.tm_mday
 datetime.hour = localtime.tm_hour
 datetime.minute = localtime.tm_min
 datetime.second = localtime.tm_sec

 offset = time.timezone if time.localtime().tm_isdst == 0 else time.altzone
 datetime.utc_hour_offset = int(offset / 60 / 60 * -1)
 datetime.utc_minute_offset = int((abs(offset) % 3600) / 60)

 return datetime

def AddAnnotations(page):
 # Add caret annotation.
 caret = Caret(page.AddAnnot(Annot.e_Caret, RectF(400, 450, 420, 470)))
 # This flag is used for printing annotations.
 caret.SetFlags(4)
 caret.SetInnerRect(RectF(410, 450, 430, 470))
 caret.SetContent("Caret annotation")
 caret.SetSubject("Caret")
 caret.SetTitle("Foxit SDK")
 caret.SetCreationDateTime(GetLocalDateTime())
 caret.SetModifiedDateTime(GetLocalDateTime())
 caret.SetUniqueID(RandomUID())
 # Appearance should be reset.
 caret.ResetAppearanceStream()
 print("Add a caret annotation.")
def main():

 # Load a document
 doc = PDFDoc("annotation_input.pdf")
 error_code = doc.Load("")

 # Get first page with index 0
 page = doc.GetPage(0)
 AddAnnotations(page)

 # Save PDF file
 doc.SaveAs(newPdf, PDFDoc.e_SaveFlagNoOriginal)

if __name__ == '__main__':
 libmgr = SDKLibMgr()
 if libmgr.Initialize():
 main()

 libmgr.Release()

How to use Foxit PDF SDK to add push button form field and get push button form field information.

```python
import os
import sys
import site
import time

if sys.version_info.major == 2:
 _PYTHON2_ = True
else:
 _PYTHON2_ = False

if _PYTHON2_:
 site.addsitedir('../../../')
 from FoxitPDFSDKPython2 import *
else:
 from FoxitPDFSDKPython3 import *

sn = ""
key = ""

class SDKLibMgr:
 def __init__(self):
 self.is_initialize_ = False
 def Initialize(self):
 # Initialize library
 error_code = Library.Initialize(sn, key)
 if error_code != e_ErrSuccess:
 print("Library Initialize Error: {}".format(error_code))
 return False
 self.is_initialize_ = True
 return True
 def Release(self):
 if self.is_initialize_:
 Library.Release()

def AddInteractiveForms(page, form):
 # Set default appearance
 default_ap = DefaultAppearance()
 default_ap.flags = DefaultAppearance.e_FlagFont | DefaultAppearance.e_FlagFontSize | DefaultAppearance.e_FlagTextColor
 default_ap.font = Font(Font.e_StdIDHelveticaB)
 default_ap.text_size = 12.0
 default_ap.text_color = 0x000000
 form.SetDefaultAppearance(default_ap)

 # Add push button field.
 btn_submit = form.AddControl(page, "Push Button Submit",
 Field.e_TypePushButton,
 RectF(50, 750, 150, 780))
 # Set default appearance
 default_ap = DefaultAppearance()
 default_ap.flags = DefaultAppearance.e_FlagFont | DefaultAppearance.e_FlagFontSize | DefaultAppearance.e_FlagTextColor
 default_ap.font = Font(Font.e_StdIDHelveticaB)
 default_ap.text_size = 12.0
 default_ap.text_color = 0x000000
 form.SetDefaultAppearance(default_ap)

 # Set push button appearance.
 widget = btn_submit.GetWidget()
 widget.SetHighlightingMode(Annot.e_HighlightingPush)
 widget.SetMKBorderColor(0xFF0000)
 widget.SetMKBackgroundColor(0xF0F0F0)
 widget.SetMKNormalCaption("Submit")
 widget.ResetAppearanceStream()

def main():
 err_ret = 0
 try:
 doc = PDFDoc()
 form = Form(doc)
 # Create a blank new page and add some form fields.
 page = doc.InsertPage(0)
 AddInteractiveForms(page, form)
 doc.SaveAs("form.pdf", PDFDoc.e_SaveFlagNoOriginal)
 except Exception as ex:
 print(ex.GetMessage())
 err_ret = 1
 return err_ret

if __name__ == '__main__':
 libmgr = SDKLibMgr()
 if libmgr.Initialize():
 main()

 libmgr.Release()
```

How to use Foxit PDF SDK to move annotation to new position in PDF coordinate system
```python
import os
import sys
import site

if sys.version_info.major == 2:
 _PYTHON2_ = True
else:
 _PYTHON2_ = False

if _PYTHON2_:
 site.addsitedir('../../../')
 from FoxitPDFSDKPython2 import *
else:
 from FoxitPDFSDKPython3 import *

sn = ""
key = ""

def main():
 error_code = Library.Initialize(sn, key)
 if error_code != e_ErrSuccess:
 return
 doc = PDFDoc("input_file.pdf")
 doc.Load("")
 pPage = doc.GetPage(0)
 fDelta = 10
 iAnnotCount = pPage.GetAnnotCount()
 for j in Range(0, iAnnotCount):
 pAnnot = pPage.GetAnnot(j)
 annotType = pAnnot.GetType()
 orgRect = pAnnot.GetRect()
 newRect = RectF()
 newRect.left = orgRect.left
 newRect.bottom = orgRect.bottom
 if Annot.e_Popup != annotType:
 newRect.left += fDelta
 newRect.bottom += fDelta
 newRect.right = orgRect.right + fDelta
 newRect.top = orgRect.top + fDelta
 pAnnot.Move(newRect)
 doc.SaveAs("output.pdf", PDFDoc.e_SaveFlagNoOriginal)
 Library.Release()
if __name__ == '__main__':
 main()
```

How to use Foxit PDF SDK to search text in all pages in PDF document.

```python
import os
import sys
import site

if sys.version_info.major == 2:
 _PYTHON2_ = True
else:
 _PYTHON2_ = False

if _PYTHON2_:
 site.addsitedir('../../../')
 from FoxitPDFSDKPython2 import *
else:
 from FoxitPDFSDKPython3 import *

sn = ""
key = ""

class SDKLibMgr:
 def __init__(self):
 self.is_initialize_ = False

 def Initialize(self):
 # Initialize library
 error_code = Library.Initialize(sn, key)
 if error_code != e_ErrSuccess:
 print("Library Initialize Error: {}".format(error_code))
 return False
 self.is_initialize_ = True
 return True
 def Release(self):
 if self.is_initialize_:
 Library.Release()

def OutputMatchedInfo(text_out, search, matched_index):
 page_index = search.GetMatchPageIndex()
 format_str = ""
 format_str = "Index of matched pattern:\t{}\r\n".format(matched_index)
 format_str = "\tpage:\t{}\r\n".format(page_index)
 format_str = "\tmatch char start index:\t{}\r\n".format( search.GetMatchStartCharIndex())
 format_str = "\tmatch char end index:\t{}\r\n".format(search.GetMatchEndCharIndex())
 format_str = "\tmatch sentence start index:\t{}\r\n".format(search.GetMatchSentenceStartIndex())
 format_str = "\tmatch sentence:\t"
 format_str += search.GetMatchSentence()
 format_str += "\r\n"
 rect_array = search.GetMatchRects()
 rect_count = rect_array.GetSize()
 format_str = "\tmatch rectangles count:\t{}\r\n".format(rect_count)
 for i in range(0, rect_count):
 rect = rect_array.GetAt(i)

def main():
 err_ret = 0

 try:
 input_file = "AboutFoxit.pdf"
 doc = PDFDoc(input_file)
 error_code = doc.Load("")
 if error_code != e_ErrSuccess:
 return 1
 # sample 1: search for all pages of doc.
 search = TextSearch(doc, None)

 start_index, end_index = 0, doc.GetPageCount() - 1
 search.SetStartPage(0)
 search.SetEndPage(doc.GetPageCount() - 1)
 pattern = "Foxit"
 search.SetPattern(pattern)

 flags = TextSearch.e_SearchNormal
 # If want to specify flags, you can do as followings:
 # flags |= TextSearch.e_SearchMatchCase
 # flags |= TextSearch.e_SearchMatchWholeWord
 # flags |= TextSearch.e_SearchConsecutive
 search.SetSearchFlags(flags)
 format_str = ""
 format_str = "Begin search "
 format_str += pattern
 format_str += " at "
 format_str += input_file
 format_str += ".\n"
 print(format_str)
 format_str = "Start index:\t{}\r\n".format(start_index)
 print(format_str)
 format_str = "End index:\t{}\r\n".format(end_index)
 print(format_str)
 format_str = "Match key:\t"
 format_str += pattern
 format_str += "\r\n"
 print(format_str)
 match_case = "Yes" if flags & TextSearch.e_SearchMatchCase else "No"
 format_str = "Match Case\t"
 format_str += match_case
 format_str += "\r\n"
 print(format_str)
 match_whole_word = "Yes" if flags & TextSearch.e_SearchMatchWholeWord else "No"
 format_str = "Match whole word:\t"
 format_str += match_whole_word
 format_str += "\r\n"
 print(format_str)
 match_consecutive = "Yes" if flags & TextSearch.e_SearchConsecutive else "No"
 format_str = "Consecutive:\t"
 format_str += match_consecutive
 format_str += "\r\n"
 print(format_str)
 match_count = 0
 while search.FindNext():
 rect_array = search.GetMatchRects()
 OutputMatchedInfo(text_out, search, match_count)
 match_count += 1

 print("Marched {} counts.\n".format(match_count))
 # end of sample 1.
 except Exception as ex:
 print(ex.GetMessage())
 err_ret = 1
 return err_ret

if __name__ == '__main__':
 libmgr = SDKLibMgr()
 if libmgr.Initialize():
 main()

 libmgr.Release()
```

How to use Foxit PDF SDK to do LTV verification in PDF document.

```python
import os
import sys
import site

if sys.version_info.major == 2:
 _PYTHON2_ = True
else:
 _PYTHON2_ = False

if _PYTHON2_:
 site.addsitedir('../../../')
 from FoxitPDFSDKPython2 import *
else:
 from FoxitPDFSDKPython3 import *

sn = ""
key = ""

output_path = "../output_files/"
input_path = "../input_files/"
output_directory = output_path + "ltv/"

class SDKLibMgr:
 def __init__(self):
 self.is_initialize_ = False

 def Initialize(self):
 # Initialize library
 error_code = Library.Initialize(sn, key)
 if error_code != e_ErrSuccess:
 print("Library Initialize Error: {}".format(error_code))
 return False
 self.is_initialize_ = True
 return True

 def Release(self):
 if self.is_initialize_:
 Library.Release()

class MyTrustedCertStoreCallback(TrustedCertStoreCallback):
 def __init__(self, *args):
 if _PYTHON2_:
 super(MyTrustedCertStoreCallback, self).__init__(*args)
 else:
 super().__init__(*args)

 def __del__(self):
 self.__disown__()

 def IsCertTrusted(self, *args):
 return True

 def IsCertTrustedRoot(self, *args):
 return True

def UseLTVVerifier(pdf_doc, is_to_add_dss):
 # Here use default RevocationCallback, so no need to call LTVVerifier.SetRevocationCallback
 ltv_verifier = LTVVerifier(pdf_doc, True, True, False,
 LTVVerifier.e_SignatureCreationTime)

 # Use implemented TrustedCertStoreCallback to trust some cerificates during LTV verification.
 # Here, the implementation of TrustedCertStoreCallback is very simple :
 # trust all input certificate(s) when this callback function is triggered during LTV verification.
 # User can improve the implementation of the callback class TrustedCertStoreCallback or choose not to use TrustedCertStoreCallback.
 my_callback = MyTrustedCertStoreCallback()
 ltv_verifier.SetTrustedCertStoreCallback(my_callback)
 ltv_verifier.SetVerifyMode(LTVVerifier.e_VerifyModeAcrobat)
 sig_verify_result_array = ltv_verifier.Verify()
 for i in range(0, sig_verify_result_array.GetSize()):
 sig_verify_result = sig_verify_result_array.GetAt(i)
 signature_name = sig_verify_result.GetSignatureName()
 sig_state = sig_verify_result.GetSignatureState()
 ltv_state = sig_verify_result.GetLTVState()
 ltv_state_str = ""
 if ltv_state == SignatureVerifyResult.e_LTVStateInactive:
 ltv_state_str = "inactive"
 elif ltv_state == SignatureVerifyResult.e_LTVStateEnable:
 ltv_state_str = "enabled"
 elif ltv_state == SignatureVerifyResult.e_LTVStateNotEnable:
 ltv_state_str = "not enabled"
 print("Signature name:{}, LTV state: {}\r\n".format(signature_name, ltv_state_str))

 if is_to_add_dss:
 for i in range(0, sig_verify_result_array.GetSize()):
 if sig_verify_result_array.GetAt(
 i).GetSignatureState() & Signature.e_StateVerifyValid:
 ltv_verifier.AddDSS(sig_verify_result_array.GetAt(i))

def main():
 err_ret = 0
 try:
 UseLTVVerifier("AboutFoxit_signed_ltv.pdf", False)
 except Exception as ex:
 print(ex.GetMessage())
 err_ret = 1
 return err_ret

if __name__ == '__main__':
 libmgr = SDKLibMgr()
 if libmgr.Initialize():
 main()
 libmgr.Release()
```

how to add square annotation

 self.is_initialize_ = False

 # Initialize library
 error_code = Library.Initialize(sn, key)

 self.is_initialize_ = True
 return True

 def Release(self):
 if self.is_initialize_:
 Library.Release()

def GetLocalDateTime():
 datetime = DateTime()
 localtime = time.localtime(time.time())
 datetime.year = localtime.tm_year
 datetime.month = localtime.tm_mon
 datetime.day = localtime.tm_mday
 datetime.hour = localtime.tm_hour
 datetime.minute = localtime.tm_min
 datetime.second = localtime.tm_sec

 offset = time.timezone if time.localtime().tm_isdst == 0 else time.altzone
 datetime.utc_hour_offset = int(offset / 60 / 60 * -1)
 datetime.utc_minute_offset = int((abs(offset) % 3600) / 60)

 return datetime

def AddAnnotations(page):
 # Add square annotation
 square = Square(page.AddAnnot(Annot.e_Square, RectF(200, 650, 300, 750)))
 # This flag is used for printing annotations.
 square.SetFlags(4)
 square.SetFillColor(0x00FF00)
 square.SetInnerRect(RectF(220, 660, 260, 740))
 square.SetSubject("Square")
 square.SetTitle("Foxit SDK")
 square.SetCreationDateTime(GetLocalDateTime())
 square.SetModifiedDateTime(GetLocalDateTime())
 square.SetUniqueID(RandomUID())
 # Appearance should be reset.
 square.ResetAppearanceStream()
 print("Add a square annotation.")

def main():

 # Load a document
 doc = PDFDoc("annotation_input.pdf")
 error_code = doc.Load("")

 # Get first page with index 0
 page = doc.GetPage(0)
 AddAnnotations(page)

 # Save PDF file
 doc.SaveAs(newPdf, PDFDoc.e_SaveFlagNoOriginal)

if __name__ == '__main__':
 libmgr = SDKLibMgr()
 if libmgr.Initialize():
 main()

 libmgr.Release()

How to use Foxit PDF SDK to do encryption and decryption for a PDF file by using custom security method

```python
import os
import sys
import site

if sys.version_info.major == 2:
 _PYTHON2_ = True
else:
 _PYTHON2_ = False

if _PYTHON2_:
 site.addsitedir('../../../')
 from FoxitPDFSDKPython2 import *
else:
 from FoxitPDFSDKPython3 import *

sn = ""
key = ""

class SDKLibMgr:

 def __init__(self):
 self.is_initialize_ = False

 def Initialize(self):
 # Initialize library
 error_code = Library.Initialize(sn, key)
 if error_code != e_ErrSuccess:
 print("Library Initialize Error: {}".format(error_code))
 return False
 self.is_initialize_ = True
 return True

 def Release(self):
 if self.is_initialize_:
 Library.Release()

class CustomSecurityEvent(CustomSecurityCallback):

 def __init__(self, *args):
 if _PYTHON2_:
 super(CustomSecurityEvent, self).__init__()
 else:
 super().__init__()

 def __del__(self):
 self.__disown__()

 def Release(self, *args):
 pass

 def CreateContext(self, *args):
 return None

 def ReleaseContext(self, *args):
 return True

 def GetUserPermissions(self, *args):
 return 0xffffffc

 def IsOwner(self, *args):
 return True

 def GetCipher(self, *args):
 return SecurityHandler.e_CipherAES

 def GetEncryptKey(self, *args):
 return "key"

 def GetDecryptedSize(self, *args):
 data_size = args[1]
 return data_size

 def StartDecryptor(self, *args):
 return None

 def DecryptData(self, *args):
 data = args[1]
 if data is None:
 return ""
 enc_data_buf = data[0]
 enc_data_len = data[1]

 return enc_data_buf

 def FinishDecryptor(self, *args):
 return ""

 def GetEncryptedSize(self, *args):
 data = args[3]
 data_buf = data[0]
 data_lengh = data[1]
 return data_lengh

 def EncryptData(self, *args):
 data = args[3]
 src_buffer = data[0]
 src_length = data[1]
 return True, (src_buffer, src_length)

 def UseStandardCryptoMethod(self, *args):
 return False

def CustomSecurity(input_file):
 try:
 doc = PDFDoc(input_file)
 error_code = doc.Load("")
 if error_code != e_ErrSuccess:
 return False

 # Do encryption.
 callback = CustomSecurityEvent()
 handler = CustomSecurityHandler()
 encrypt_info = "Foxit simple demo custom security"
 encrypt_data = CustomEncryptData(True, "Custom", "foxit-simple-demo")
 handler.Initialize(encrypt_data, callback, encrypt_info)
 doc.SetSecurityHandler(handler)
 output_file = "custom_encrypt.pdf"
 doc.SaveAs(output_file, PDFDoc.e_SaveFlagNoOriginal)

 # Do decryption.
 Library.RegisterSecurityCallback("Custom", callback)
 encrypted_doc = PDFDoc(output_file)

 error_code = encrypted_doc.Load("")
 if error_code != e_ErrSuccess:
 return False
 output_file = "custom_decrypt.pdf"
 encrypted_doc.RemoveSecurity()
 encrypted_doc.SaveAs(output_file, PDFDoc.e_SaveFlagNoOriginal)
 Library.UnregisterSecurityCallback("Custom")
 except Exception as ex:
 print(ex.GetMessage())
 return False
 return True

def main():
 err_ret = 0
 try:
 input_file = "AboutFoxit.pdf"
 CustomSecurity(input_file)
 except Exception as ex:
 print(ex.GetMessage())
 err_ret = 1

 return err_ret

if __name__ == '__main__':
 libmgr = SDKLibMgr()
 if libmgr.Initialize():
 main()

 libmgr.Release()
```

how to verify converted result PDF file
import os
import sys
import site
if sys.version_info.major == 2:
_PYTHON2_ = True
else:
_PYTHON2_ = False
if _PYTHON2_:
#replace with the python2 lib path
site.addsitedir(‘../../../’)
from FoxitPDFSDKPython2 import *
else:
from FoxitPDFSDKPython3 import *
sn = " "
key = " "

class SDKLibMgr:

 def __init__(self):
 self.is_initialize_ = False

 def Initialize(self):
 # Initialize library
 error_code = Library.Initialize(sn, key)

 self.is_initialize_ = True
 return True

 def Release(self):
 if self.is_initialize_:
 Library.Release()
def OutputPDFAHitData(result_info, output_txt_path):
 text_doc = TextDoc(output_txt_path, "wb+")

 hit_data_count = result_info.GetHitDataCount()
 temp_string = "== Hit Data, count:{:d} ==\r\n".format(hit_data_count)

 text_doc.Write(temp_string)
 for i in range(0, hit_data_count):
 hit_data = result_info.GetHitData(i)
 temp_string = "Triggered count:{:d}\r\n".format(
 hit_data.triggered_count)

 text_doc.Write(temp_string)
 text_doc.Write("Name:")
 text_doc.Write(hit_data.name)
 text_doc.Write("\r\n")
 text_doc.Write("Comment:")
 text_doc.Write(hit_data.comment)
 text_doc.Write("\r\n")
 text_doc.Write("Trigger value:")
 trigger_value_count = hit_data.trigger_values.GetSize()
 if trigger_value_count < 1:
 text_doc.Write("\r\n")
 else:
 for z in range(0, trigger_value_count):
 text_doc.Write("\t")
 text_doc.Write(hit_data.trigger_values.GetAt(z))
 text_doc.Write("\r\n")

 temp_string = "Check severity:{:d}\r\nPage index:{:d}\r\n".format(
 hit_data.severity, hit_data.page_index)
 text_doc.Write(temp_string)
 text_doc.Write("\r\n")

def OutputPDFAFixupData(result_info, output_txt_path):
 text_doc = TextDoc(output_txt_path, "wb+")

 fixup_count = result_info.GetFixupDataCount()
 temp_string = "== Fixup Data, count:{:d} ==\r\n".format(fixup_count)

 text_doc.Write(temp_string)
 for i in range(0, fixup_count):
 fixup_data = result_info.GetFixupData(i)

 temp_string = "Used count:{}\r\n".format(fixup_data.used_count)
 text_doc.Write(temp_string)
 text_doc.Write("Name:{fixup_data.name}\r\nComment:{fixup_data.comment}\r\nReason:)
 reason_count = fixup_data.reasons.GetSize()
 if reason_count < 1:
 text_doc.Write("\r\n")
 else:
 for z in range(0, reason_count):
 text_doc.Write("\t{fixup_data.reasons.GetAt(z)}\r\n")

 temp_string = "State value:{}\r\n".format(fixup_data.state)
 text_doc.Write(temp_string)
 text_doc.Write("\r\n")

def OutputPDFAHitData(result_info, output_txt_path):
 text_doc = TextDoc(output_txt_path, "wb+")

 hit_data_count = result_info.GetHitDataCount()
 temp_string = "== Hit Data, count:{:d} ==\r\n".format(hit_data_count)

 text_doc.Write(temp_string)
 for i in range(0, hit_data_count):
 hit_data = result_info.GetHitData(i)
 temp_string = "Triggered count:{:d}\r\n".format(
 hit_data.triggered_count)
 text_doc.Write(temp_string)
 text_doc.Write(f"Name:{hit_data.name}\r\nComment:{hit_data.comment}\r\n")

 text_doc.Write("Trigger value:")
 trigger_value_count = hit_data.trigger_values.GetSize()
 if trigger_value_count < 1:
 text_doc.Write("\r\n")
 else:
 for z in range(0, trigger_value_count):
 text_doc.Write("\t{hit_data.trigger_values.GetAt(z)}\r\n")

 temp_string = "Check severity:{:d}\r\nPage index:{:d}\r\n".format(hit_data.severity, hit_data.page_index)
 text_doc.Write(temp_string)
 text_doc.Write("\r\n")

def main():
 # Initialize compliance engine.
 error_code = ComplianceEngine.Initialize(compliance_resource_folder_path, compliance_engine_unlockcode)
 if error_code != e_ErrSuccess:

 # Verify converted result PDF file, which is not expected to be PDFA-1a compliant as the original did not have accessibility structures.
 verify_progress_callback_2 = MyComplianceProgressCallback(
 "1_2_pdfacompliance_verify_after_convert_progressdata.txt")
 verify_result_info_2 = pdfa_compliance.Verify(
 PDFACompliance.e_VersionPDFA1a, save_pdf_path, 0, -1,
 verify_progress_callback_2)
 OutputPDFAHitData( verify_result_info_2, "1_2_pdfacompliance_verify_after_convert_hitdata.txt")

 # Release compliance engine.
 ComplianceEngine.Release()

if __name__ == '__main__':
 libmgr = SDKLibMgr()
 if libmgr.Initialize():
 main()

 libmgr.Release()

```python
 if len(sys.argv) > 1 and sys.argv[1] == "--help":
 ShowhelpMessage()
 return 0
 isfilestreamload = False;
 err_ret = 0

 # "engine_path" is the path of the engine file "fxhtml2pdf" which is used to convert html to pdf. Please refer to Developer Guide for more details.
 engine_path = ""

 # "cookies_path" is the path of the cookies file exported from the web pages that you want to convert. Please refer to Developer Guide for more details.
 cookies_path = ""

 time_out = 15
 try:
```

how to generate a barcode bitmap from a string
import os
import sys
import site
if sys.version_info.major == 2:
_PYTHON2_ = True
else:
_PYTHON2_ = False
if _PYTHON2_:
#replace with the python2 lib path
site.addsitedir(‘../../../’)
from FoxitPDFSDKPython2 import *
else:
from FoxitPDFSDKPython3 import *
sn = " "
key = " "

class SDKLibMgr:

 def __init__(self):
 self.is_initialize_ = False

 def Initialize(self):
 # Initialize library
 error_code = Library.Initialize(sn, key)

 self.is_initialize_ = True
 return True

 def Release(self):
 if self.is_initialize_:
 Library.Release()

def Save2Image(bitMap, bmp_name):
 image = Image()
 image.AddFrame(bitMap)

 filepath = output_directory + bmp_name
 image.SaveAs(filepath)

def Barcode_GenerateEachType(code_string, code_format, unit_width, unit_height, qr_level, bmp_name):

 barcode = Barcode()
 bitmap = barcode.GenerateBitmap(code_string, code_format, unit_width, unit_height, qr_level)

 Save2Image(bitmap, bmp_name)

def Barcode_GenerateAll():
 #Strings used as barcode content.
 sz_code_string = ("T", "90", "3", "35", "632", "9", "Unknown", "QrCode")
 #Barcode format types
 code_format = (Barcode.e_FormatCode39, Barcode.e_FormatCode128,
 Barcode.e_FormatEAN8, Barcode.e_FormatUPCA,
 Barcode.e_FormatEAN13, Barcode.e_FormatITF,
 Barcode.e_FormatPDF417, Barcode.e_FormatQRCode)

 #Image names for the saved image files.(except QR code)
 sz_bmp_name = ("T.bmp", "8090.bmp","313.bmp", "35.bmp", "32.bmp", "9.bmp", "Unknown.bmp")

 #Format error correction level of QR code.
 sz_qr_level = (Barcode.e_QRCorrectionLevelLow, Barcode.e_QRCorrectionLevelMedium,
 Barcode.e_QRCorrectionLevelQuater, Barcode.e_QRCorrectionLevelHigh)
 #Image names for the saved image files for QR code.
 bmp_qr_name = ("L.bmp", "M.bmp","Q.bmp", "H.bmp")

 unit_width = 2
 unit_height = 120

 #Generate barcode for different types.
 for i in range(0, 8):
 if code_format[i] != Barcode.e_FormatQRCode:
 Barcode_GenerateEachType(sz_code_string[i], code_format[i], unit_width, unit_height, 0, sz_bmp_name[i])
 else:
 for j in range(0, 4):
 Barcode_GenerateEachType(sz_code_string[i], code_format[i], unit_width, unit_height, sz_qr_level[j], bmp_qr_name[j])

def main():

 Barcode_GenerateAll()

if __name__ == '__main__':
 libmgr = SDKLibMgr()
 if libmgr.Initialize():
 main()

 libmgr.Release()

How to get marked content from graphics objects.

```python
import os
import sys
import site

if sys.version_info.major == 2:
 _PYTHON2_ = True
else:
 _PYTHON2_ = False

if _PYTHON2_:
 site.addsitedir('../../../')
 from FoxitPDFSDKPython2 import *
else:
 from FoxitPDFSDKPython3 import *

sn = ""
key = ""

class SDKLibMgr:
 def __init__(self):
 self.is_initialize_ = False
 def Initialize(self):
 # Initialize library
 error_code = Library.Initialize(sn, key)
 if error_code != e_ErrSuccess:
 print("Library Initialize Error: {}".format(error_code))
 return False
 self.is_initialize_ = True
 return True

 def Release(self):
 if self.is_initialize_:
 Library.Release()

def GetMarkedContentObject(pdf_file):
 doc = PDFDoc(pdf_file)
 ret = doc.Load("")
 if ret != e_ErrSuccess:
 print("[Failed] Cannot load PDF document {}.\r\n Error message:{}\r\n".
 format(pdf_file, ret))
 return False

 page = doc.GetPage(0)
 page.StartParse(PDFPage.e_ParsePageNormal, None, False)
 position = page.GetFirstGraphicsObjectPosition(GraphicsObject.e_TypeText)
 text_obj = page.GetGraphicsObject(position).GetTextObject()
 content = text_obj.GetMarkedContent()
 item_count = content.GetItemCount()

 file_info = output_directory + "markedcontent.txt"
 text_doc = TextDoc(file_info, "wb+")
 # Get marked content property
 for i in range(0, item_count):
 print("index: {}\r\n".format(i))
 tag_name = content.GetItemTagName(i)
 print("Tag name: {}\r\n".format(tag_name))
 mcid = content.GetItemMCID(i)
 print("mcid: {}\r\n".format(mcid))
 return True

def main():
 err_ret = 0

 if not os.path.exists(output_directory):
 os.makedirs(output_directory)
 try:
 if not GetMarkedContentObject("marked_content.pdf"):
 return 1
 except Exception as ex:
 print(ex.GetMessage())
 err_ret = 1
 return err_ret

if __name__ == '__main__':
 libmgr = SDKLibMgr()
 if libmgr.Initialize():
 main()

 libmgr.Release()
```

How to use Foxit PDF SDK to convert PDF files to Word format files by PDF file path.

```python
import os
import sys
import site

if sys.version_info.major == 2:
 _PYTHON2_ = True
else:
 _PYTHON2_ = False

if _PYTHON2_:
 site.addsitedir('../../../')
 from FoxitPDFSDKPython2 import *
else:
 from FoxitPDFSDKPython3 import *

sn = ""
key = ""

class SDKLibMgr:
 def __init__(self):
 self.is_initialize_ = False
 def Initialize(self):
 # Initialize library
 error_code = Library.Initialize(sn, key)
 if error_code != e_ErrSuccess:
 return False
 self.is_initialize_ = True
 return True

 def Release(self):
 if self.is_initialize_:
 Library.Release()

def main():
 err_ret = 0
 try:
 PDF2Office.Initialize("") # Please ensure the path is valid.
 # Convert PDF file to Word format file.
 setting_data = PDF2OfficeSettingData()
 # Disable machine learning-based recognition functionality
 setting_data.enable_ml_recognition = False;
 setting_data.metrics_data_folder_path = "" # Please ensure the path is valid.
 callback = CustomConvertCallback()
 progressive = PDF2Office.StartConvertToWord("word.pdf", "", "pdf2word_result.docx", setting_data, callback)
 if progressive.GetRateOfProgress() != 100:
 state = Progressive.e_ToBeContinued
 while (Progressive.e_ToBeContinued == state):
 state = progressive.Continue()

 PDF2Office.Release()
 except Exception as ex:
 print(ex.GetMessage())
 err_ret = 1

 return err_ret

if __name__ == '__main__':
 libmgr = SDKLibMgr()
 if libmgr.Initialize():
 main()

 libmgr.Release()
```

How to use Foxit PDF SDK to do PDF page organization such as importing page from a PDF document.

```python
import os
import sys
import site

if sys.version_info.major == 2:
 _PYTHON2_ = True
else:
 _PYTHON2_ = False

if _PYTHON2_:
 site.addsitedir('../../../')
 from FoxitPDFSDKPython2 import *
else:
 from FoxitPDFSDKPython3 import *

sn = ""
key = ""

class SDKLibMgr:
 def __init__(self):
 self.is_initialize_ = False

 def Initialize(self):
 # Initialize library
 error_code = Library.Initialize(sn, key)
 if error_code != e_ErrSuccess:
 return False
 self.is_initialize_ = True
 return True
 def Release(self):
 if self.is_initialize_:
 Library.Release()

# You can implement the functionality of exporting pages by creating an empty document
# and importing part of the source document into the empty document.
# You can also import the target document as a source document
# to implement the copy page functionality.
def ImportPage():
 file_dest = "page_organization_123.pdf"
 file_src = "page_organization_abc.pdf"
 doc_dest = PDFDoc(file_dest)
 code = doc_dest.Load("")
 if code != e_ErrSuccess:
 return False

 doc_src = PDFDoc(file_src)
 code = doc_src.Load("")
 if code != e_ErrSuccess:
 return False

 # Import page from PDFDoc object.
 import_ranges = Range(0)
 import_ranges.AddSingle(doc_src.GetPageCount() - 1)
 progressive = doc_dest.StartImportPages(-1, doc_src,PDFDoc.e_ImportFlagNormal, "abc",
 import_ranges, None)
 while progressive.Continue() != Progressive.e_Finished:
 pass
 output_file = "page_organization_abc_to_123_import_pages.pdf"
 doc_dest.SaveAs(output_file, PDFDoc.e_SaveFlagNormal)

 doc_dest = PDFDoc(file_dest)
 code = doc_dest.Load("")
 if code != e_ErrSuccess:
 return False

 # Import page from file path.
 progressive = doc_dest.StartImportPagesFromFilePath(
 -1, file_src, "", PDFDoc.e_ImportFlagNormal, "abc", import_ranges,
 None)
 while progressive.Continue() != Progressive.e_Finished:
 pass
 output_file = "abc_to_123_import_pages_form_filepath.pdf"
 doc_dest.SaveAs(output_file, PDFDoc.e_SaveFlagNormal)
 return True

def main():
 err_ret = 0
 try:
 if not ImportPage():
 err_ret = 1
 except Exception as ex:
 print(ex.GetMessage())
 err_ret = 1
 return err_ret

if __name__ == '__main__':
 libmgr = SDKLibMgr()
 if libmgr.Initialize():
 main()

 libmgr.Release()
```

how to add link annotation
import os
import sys
import time
import math
import site
import wave
from uuid import *

if sys.version_info.major == 2:
_PYTHON2_ = True
else:
_PYTHON2_ = False
if _PYTHON2_:
#replace with the python2 lib path
site.addsitedir(‘../../../’)
from FoxitPDFSDKPython2 import *
else:
from FoxitPDFSDKPython3 import *
sn = " "
key = " "

class SDKLibMgr:

 def __init__(self):
 self.is_initialize_ = False

 def Initialize(self):
 # Initialize library
 error_code = Library.Initialize(sn, key)

 self.is_initialize_ = True
 return True

 def Release(self):
 if self.is_initialize_:
 Library.Release()

def GetLocalDateTime():
 datetime = DateTime()
 localtime = time.localtime(time.time())
 datetime.year = localtime.tm_year
 datetime.month = localtime.tm_mon
 datetime.day = localtime.tm_mday
 datetime.hour = localtime.tm_hour
 datetime.minute = localtime.tm_min
 datetime.second = localtime.tm_sec

 offset = time.timezone if time.localtime().tm_isdst == 0 else time.altzone
 datetime.utc_hour_offset = int(offset / 60 / 60 * -1)
 datetime.utc_minute_offset = int((abs(offset) % 3600) / 60)

 return datetime

def AddAnnotations(page):
# Add link annotation
 link = Link(page.AddAnnot(Annot.e_Link, RectF(350, 350, 380, 400)))
 # This flag is used for printing annotations.
 link.SetFlags(4)
 link.SetHighlightingMode(Annot.e_HighlightingPush)

 # Add action for link annotation
 action = URIAction(Action.Create(page.GetDocument(), Action.e_TypeURI))
 action.SetTrackPositionFlag(True)
 action.SetURI("www.foxitsoftware.com")
 link.SetAction(action)
 # Appearance should be reset.
 link.ResetAppearanceStream()
 print("Add a link annotation.")

def main():

 # Load a document
 doc = PDFDoc("annotation_input.pdf")
 error_code = doc.Load("")

 # Get first page with index 0
 page = doc.GetPage(0)
 AddAnnotations(page)

 # Save PDF file
 doc.SaveAs(newPdf, PDFDoc.e_SaveFlagNoOriginal)

if __name__ == '__main__':
 libmgr = SDKLibMgr()
 if libmgr.Initialize():
 main()

 libmgr.Release()

How to use Foxit PDF SDK to print PDF.

```python
import os
import sys
import site
import platform
from ctypes import *

if sys.version_info.major == 2:
 _PYTHON2_ = True
else:
 _PYTHON2_ = False

if _PYTHON2_:
 site.addsitedir('../../../')
 from FoxitPDFSDKPython2 import *
else:
 from FoxitPDFSDKPython3 import *

sn = ""
key = ""

HORZRES = 8
VERTRES = 10
SP_ERROR = -1

class RECT(Structure):
 _fields_ = [
 ('left', c_long),
 ('top', c_long),
 ('right', c_long),
 ('bottom', c_long)]

# WINVER >= 0x0400
class DOCINFOW(Structure):
 _fields_ = [
 ('cbSize', c_int),
 ('lpszDocName', c_wchar_p),
 ('lpszOutput', c_wchar_p),
 ('lpszDatatype', c_wchar_p),
 ('fwType', c_ulong)
 ]

def main():
 err_ret = 0
 if not os.path.exists(output_directory):
 os.makedirs(output_directory)
 plat = platform.architecture()
 # 32-bit Python on Windows x64
 if platform.machine().endswith('64') and plat[0] == '32bit':
 windll.LoadLibrary('C:/Windows/SysWOW64/gdi32.dll')
 windll.LoadLibrary('C:/Windows/SysWOW64/user32.dll')
 gdi = WinDLL('C:/Windows/SysWOW64/gdi32.dll')
 user32 = WinDLL('C:/Windows/SysWOW64/user32.dll')
 else:
 windll.LoadLibrary('C:/Windows/System32/gdi32.dll')
 windll.LoadLibrary('C:/Windows/System32/user32.dll')
 gdi = WinDLL('C:/Windows/System32/gdi32.dll')
 user32 = WinDLL('C:/Windows/System32/user32.dll')
 GetProfileStringW = windll.kernel32.GetProfileStringW
 try:
 # Load PDF document.
 doc = PDFDoc("annotations.pdf")
 error_code = doc.Load("")
 if error_code != e_ErrSuccess:
 return 1
 str_return = c_wchar_p("")
 str_app = c_wchar_p("windows")
 str_key = c_wchar_p("device")
 str_defalut = c_wchar_p(",,,")
 size = c_int(120)
 # Retrieve the printer, printer driver, and output-port names from WIN.INI.
 GetProfileStringW(str_app, str_key, str_defalut, str_return, size)
 split_value = str_return.value.split(',')
 hdc = gdi.CreateDCW(c_wchar_p(split_value[1]), c_wchar_p(
 split_value[0]), c_wchar_p(split_value[2]), None)
 if hdc is None:
 return 1
 doc_name = 'printing_annotations.pdf'
 doc_info = DOCINFOW(sizeof(DOCINFOW), c_wchar_p(doc_name), None, None, 0)
 error = gdi.StartDocW(hdc, byref(doc_info))
 if (error == SP_ERROR):
 return 1
 for i in range(0, doc.GetPageCount()):
 page = doc.GetPage(i)
 page.StartParse(PDFPage.e_ParsePageNormal, None, False)
 width = int(page.GetWidth())
 height = int(page.GetHeight())
 error = gdi.StartPage(hdc)
 if (error == SP_ERROR):
 return 1
 device_width = gdi.GetDeviceCaps(hdc, c_int(HORZRES))
 device_height = gdi.GetDeviceCaps(hdc, c_int(VERTRES))
 x_scale = device_width / width
 y_scale = device_height / height
 scale = x_scale if x_scale < y_scale else y_scale
 x_o = 0.0
 y_o = 0.0
 if x_scale < y_scale:
 y_o = (device_height - scale * height) / 2
 device_height = scale * height
 else:
 x_o = (device_width - scale * width) / 2
 device_width = scale * width
 rect = RECT(c_long(int(x_o)), c_long(int(y_o)), c_long(
 int(device_width + x_o)), c_long(int(device_height + y_o)))
 m = page.GetDisplayMatrix(int(x_o), int(y_o), int(device_width + x_o), int(device_height + y_o),
 e_Rotation0)
 hbrush = gdi.CreateSolidBrush(0xffffff)
 user32.FillRect(hdc, byref(rect), hbrush)
 gdi.DeleteObject(hbrush)
 r = Renderer(hdc, split_value[0])
 r.EnableForPrint(True)
 clip_rect = RectI(int(x_o), int(y_o), int(device_width + x_o), int(device_height + y_o))
 r.SetClipRect(clip_rect)
 r.StartRender(page, m, None)
 gdi.EndPage(hdc)
 gdi.EndDoc(hdc)
 gdi.DeleteDC(hdc)
 except Exception as ex:
 print(ex.GetMessage())
 err_ret = 1
 return err_ret

if __name__ == '__main__':
 if(Library.Initialize(sn, key) == e_ErrSuccess)
 main()
	libmgr.Release()
```

how to add freetext annotation with richtext as type writer
import os
import sys
import time
import math
import site
import wave
from uuid import *

if sys.version_info.major == 2:
_PYTHON2_ = True
else:
_PYTHON2_ = False
if _PYTHON2_:
#replace with the python2 lib path
site.addsitedir(‘../../../’)
from FoxitPDFSDKPython2 import *
else:
from FoxitPDFSDKPython3 import *
sn = " "
key = " "

class SDKLibMgr:

 def __init__(self):
 self.is_initialize_ = False

 def Initialize(self):
 # Initialize library
 error_code = Library.Initialize(sn, key)

 self.is_initialize_ = True
 return True

 def Release(self):
 if self.is_initialize_:
 Library.Release()

def GetLocalDateTime():
 datetime = DateTime()
 localtime = time.localtime(time.time())
 datetime.year = localtime.tm_year
 datetime.month = localtime.tm_mon
 datetime.day = localtime.tm_mday
 datetime.hour = localtime.tm_hour
 datetime.minute = localtime.tm_min
 datetime.second = localtime.tm_sec

 offset = time.timezone if time.localtime().tm_isdst == 0 else time.altzone
 datetime.utc_hour_offset = int(offset / 60 / 60 * -1)
 datetime.utc_minute_offset = int((abs(offset) % 3600) / 60)

 return datetime

def AddAnnotations(page):
# Add freetext annotation with richtext, as type writer.
 freetext = FreeText(
 page.AddAnnot(Annot.e_FreeText, RectF(10, 50, 200, 100)))
 # This flag is used for printing annotations.
 freetext.SetFlags(4)
 # Set default appearance
 default_ap = DefaultAppearance()
 default_ap.flags = DefaultAppearance.e_FlagFont | DefaultAppearance.e_FlagFontSize | DefaultAppearance.e_FlagTextColor
 default_ap.font = Font(Font.e_StdIDHelvetica)
 default_ap.text_size = 12.0
 default_ap.text_color = 0x000000
 # Set default appearance for form.
 freetext.SetDefaultAppearance(default_ap)
 freetext.SetIntent("FreeTextTypewriter")
 freetext.SetContent("A typewriter annotation")
 freetext.SetSubject("FreeTextTypewriter")
 freetext.SetTitle("Foxit SDK")
 freetext.SetCreationDateTime(GetLocalDateTime())
 freetext.SetModifiedDateTime(GetLocalDateTime())
 freetext.SetUniqueID(RandomUID())
 richtext_style = RichTextStyle()
 if sys.platform == "linux":
 richtext_style.font = Font("FreeSerif", 0, Font.e_CharsetANSI, 0)
 else:
 richtext_style.font = Font("Times New Roman", 0, Font.e_CharsetANSI, 0)

 richtext_style.text_color = 0xFF0000
 richtext_style.text_size = 10
 freetext.AddRichText("Typewriter annotation ", richtext_style)

 richtext_style.text_color = 0x00FF00
 richtext_style.is_underline = True
 freetext.AddRichText("1-underline ", richtext_style)

 if sys.platform == "linux":
 richtext_style.font = Font("FreeSans", 0, Font.e_CharsetANSI, 0)
 else:
 richtext_style.font = Font("Calibri", 0, Font.e_CharsetANSI, 0)

 richtext_style.text_color = 0x0000FF
 richtext_style.is_underline = False
 richtext_style.is_strikethrough = True
 richtext_count = freetext.GetRichTextCount()
 freetext.InsertRichText(richtext_count - 1, "2_strikethrough ",
 richtext_style)
freetext.ResetAppearanceStream()

def main():

 # Load a document
 doc = PDFDoc("annotation_input.pdf")
 error_code = doc.Load("")

 # Get first page with index 0
 page = doc.GetPage(0)
 AddAnnotations(page)

 # Save PDF file
 doc.SaveAs(newPdf, PDFDoc.e_SaveFlagNoOriginal)

if __name__ == '__main__':
 libmgr = SDKLibMgr()
 if libmgr.Initialize():
 main()

 libmgr.Release()

How to use Foxit PDF SDK to reflow PDF pages continuous

```python
import os
import sys
import site
import math

if sys.version_info.major == 2:
 _PYTHON2_ = True
else:
 _PYTHON2_ = False

if _PYTHON2_:
 site.addsitedir('../../../')
 from FoxitPDFSDKPython2 import *
else:
 from FoxitPDFSDKPython3 import *

sn = ""
key = ""

class SDKLibMgr:
 def __init__(self):
 self.is_initialize_ = False
 def Initialize(self):
 # Initialize library
 error_code = Library.Initialize(sn, key)
 if error_code != e_ErrSuccess:
 return False
 self.is_initialize_ = True
 return True

 def Release(self):
 if self.is_initialize_:
 Library.Release()

def SaveBitmap(bitmap, index, file_name):
 margin = RectF(50, 30, 30, 30)
 size = PointF(480, 800)
 rect = RectI(0, 0, int(size.x), int(margin.top))
 bitmap.FillRect(0xFFFFFFFF, rect)
 rect = RectI(0, int(size.y - margin.bottom), int(size.x), int(size.y))
 bitmap.FillRect(0xFFFFFFFF, rect)
 image = Image()
 image.AddFrame(bitmap)
 sIndex = "{}".format(index)
 save_path = output_directory + "reflow" + file_name + sIndex + ".bmp"
 image.SaveAs(save_path)

# Fixed bitmap size, just to simulate split screen situation.
def ReflowContinuous(doc):
 margin = RectF(50, 30, 30, 30)
 size = PointF(480, 800)
 display_height = size.y - margin.top - margin.bottom
 bitmap = Bitmap(int(size.x), int(size.y), Bitmap.e_DIBArgb)
 offset_y = 0
 page_count = doc.GetPageCount()
 bitmap_index = 0

 for i in range(0, page_count):
 page = doc.GetPage(i)
 # Parse PDF page.
 page.StartParse(PDFPage.e_ParsePageNormal, None, False)
 reflow_page = ReflowPage(page)
 # Set some arguments used for parsing the relfow page.
 reflow_page.SetLineSpace(0)
 reflow_page.SetScreenMargin(int(margin.left), int(margin.top),int(margin.right), int(margin.bottom))
 reflow_page.SetScreenSize(size.x, size.y)
 reflow_page.SetZoom(100)
 reflow_page.SetParseFlags(ReflowPage.e_WithImage)
 reflow_page.SetTopSpace(offset_y)
 # Parse reflow page.
 reflow_page.StartParse(None)

 # Get actual size of content of reflow page.
 # The content size does not contain the margin but contains the top space.
 content_height = reflow_page.GetContentHeight()
 content_width = reflow_page.GetContentWidth()
 # Render reflow page.
 renderer = Renderer(bitmap, False)
 matrix = reflow_page.GetDisplayMatrix(0, 0, int(content_width),int(content_height), e_Rotation0)
 renderer.StartRenderReflowPage(reflow_page, matrix, None)

 rate_need_screen_count = int(
 math.ceil(
 max(content_height - display_height, 0.0) / display_height))
 if rate_need_screen_count > 0:
 # Before do next rendering, save current bitmap first.
 file_name = "_continuous_"
 SaveBitmap(bitmap, bitmap_index, file_name)
 bitmap_index += 1

 has_display_height = display_height
 for j in range(0, rate_need_screen_count):
 # Clear the bitmap and used it to do next rendering.
 bitmap.FillRect(0xFFFFFFFF, None)
 # Render reflow page.
 renderer = Renderer(bitmap, False)
 matrix = reflow_page.GetDisplayMatrix(0, -has_display_height,int(content_width),int(content_height),e_Rotation0)
 renderer.StartRenderReflowPage(reflow_page, matrix, None)
 if j != rate_need_screen_count - 1:
 has_display_height += display_height
 SaveBitmap(bitmap, bitmap_index, file_name)
 bitmap_index += 1
 else:
 offset_y = content_height - rate_need_screen_count * display_height
 else:
 offset_y = content_height
 SaveBitmap(bitmap, bitmap_index, "_continuous_")

def main():
 err_ret = 0

 try:
 doc = PDFDoc("AboutFoxit.pdf")
 error_code = doc.Load("")
 if error_code != e_ErrSuccess:
 return 1
 ReflowContinuous(doc)

 except Exception as ex:
 print(ex.GetMessage())
 err_ret = 1
 return err_ret

if __name__ == '__main__':
 libmgr = SDKLibMgr()
 if libmgr.Initialize():
 main()

 libmgr.Release()
```

How to use Foxit PDF SDK to create a PDF document, insert the text objects into the created PDF document.

```python
import os
import sys
import site

if sys.version_info.major == 2:
 _PYTHON2_ = True
else:
 _PYTHON2_ = False

if _PYTHON2_:
 site.addsitedir('../../../')
 from FoxitPDFSDKPython2 import *
else:
 from FoxitPDFSDKPython3 import *

sn = ""
key = ""

class SDKLibMgr:
 def __init__(self):
 self.is_initialize_ = False
 def Initialize(self):
 # Initialize library
 error_code = Library.Initialize(sn, key)
 if error_code != e_ErrSuccess:
 print("Library Initialize Error: {}".format(error_code))
 return False
 self.is_initialize_ = True
 return True
 def Release(self):
 if self.is_initialize_:
 Library.Release()

class TextDoc:
 def __init__(self, *args):
 if len(args) != 2:
 raise ValueError("Input expect two parameter numbers")
 self.file = open(args[0], args[1])

 def __del__(self, *args):
 self.file.close()

 def Write(self, *args):
 buf = args[0]
 if len(args) > 1:
 for i in range(0, args[0]):
 if _PYTHON2_:
 self.file.write(args[1])
 else:
 self.file.write(bytes(args[1], encoding="utf-8"))
 buf = args[2]

 if _PYTHON2_:
 self.file.write(buf)
 else:
 self.file.write(bytes(buf, encoding="utf-8"))
 self.file.flush()

def AddTextObjects(page):
 position = page.GetLastGraphicsObjectPosition(GraphicsObject.e_TypeText)
 text_object = TextObject.Create()

 text_object.SetFillColor(0xFFFF7F00)

 # Prepare text state
 state = TextState()
 state.font_size = 80.0
 state.font = Font("Simsun", Font.e_StylesSmallCap, Font.e_CharsetGB2312, 0)
 state.textmode = TextState.e_ModeFill
 text_object.SetTextState(page, state, False, 750)

 # Set text.
 text_object.SetText("Foxit Software")
 last_position = page.InsertGraphicsObject(position, text_object)

 rect = text_object.GetRect()
 offset_x = (page.GetWidth() - (rect.right - rect.left)) / 2
 offset_y = page.GetHeight() * 0.8 - (rect.top - rect.bottom) / 2
 text_object.Transform(Matrix2D(1, 0, 0, 1, offset_x, offset_y), False)

 # Generate content
 page.GenerateContent()

def main():
 err_ret = 0
 try:
 doc = PDFDoc("graphics_objects.pdf")
 error_code = doc.Load("")

 if error_code != e_ErrSuccess:
 return 1
 # Add a new PDF page and insert text objects.
 page = doc.InsertPage(0)
 AddTextObjects(page)
 doc.SaveAs("graphics_objects.pdf", PDFDoc.e_SaveFlagNormal)
 print("Add graphics objects to PDF file.")

 except Exception as ex:
 print(ex.GetMessage())
 err_ret = 1

 return err_ret

if __name__ == '__main__':
 libmgr = SDKLibMgr()
 if libmgr.Initialize():
 main()

 libmgr.Release()

```

from FoxitPDFSDKPython2 import *

How to use Foxit PDF SDK to add radio button form field and get radio button form field information.

```python
import os
import sys
import site
import time

if sys.version_info.major == 2:
 _PYTHON2_ = True
else:
 _PYTHON2_ = False

if _PYTHON2_:
 site.addsitedir('../../../')
 from FoxitPDFSDKPython2 import *
else:
 from FoxitPDFSDKPython3 import *

sn = ""
key = ""

class SDKLibMgr:
 def __init__(self):
 self.is_initialize_ = False
 def Initialize(self):
 # Initialize library
 error_code = Library.Initialize(sn, key)
 if error_code != e_ErrSuccess:
 print("Library Initialize Error: {}".format(error_code))
 return False
 self.is_initialize_ = True
 return True
 def Release(self):
 if self.is_initialize_:
 Library.Release()

def AddInteractiveForms(page, form):
 # Set default appearance
 default_ap = DefaultAppearance()
 default_ap.flags = DefaultAppearance.e_FlagFont | DefaultAppearance.e_FlagFontSize | DefaultAppearance.e_FlagTextColor
 default_ap.font = Font(Font.e_StdIDHelveticaB)
 default_ap.text_size = 12.0
 default_ap.text_color = 0x000000
 form.SetDefaultAppearance(default_ap)

 # Add radio button group
 control = form.AddControl(page, "Radio Button0", Field.e_TypeRadioButton,
 RectF(50.0, 700, 90, 740))
 control1 = form.AddControl(page, "Radio Button0", Field.e_TypeRadioButton,
 RectF(100.0, 700, 140, 740))
 control.SetExportValue("YES")
 control.SetChecked(True)
 # Update radio button's appearance.
 control.GetWidget().ResetAppearanceStream()

 control1.SetExportValue("NO")
 control1.SetChecked(False)
 # Update radio button's appearance.
 control1.GetWidget().ResetAppearanceStream()

 print("Add radio button.")

def main():
 err_ret = 0
 try:
 doc = PDFDoc()
 form = Form(doc)
 # Create a blank new page and add some form fields.
 page = doc.InsertPage(0)
 AddInteractiveForms(page, form)
 doc.SaveAs("form.pdf", PDFDoc.e_SaveFlagNoOriginal)
 except Exception as ex:
 print(ex.GetMessage())
 err_ret = 1
 return err_ret

if __name__ == '__main__':
 libmgr = SDKLibMgr()
 if libmgr.Initialize():
 main()

 libmgr.Release()
```

How to use Foxit PDF SDK to edit layer tree of a PDF.

```python
import os
import sys
import site
import re

if sys.version_info.major == 2:
 _PYTHON2_ = True
else:
 _PYTHON2_ = False

if _PYTHON2_:
 site.addsitedir('../../../')
 from FoxitPDFSDKPython2 import *
else:
 from FoxitPDFSDKPython3 import *

sn = ""
key = ""

class SDKLibMgr:
 def __init__(self):
 self.is_initialize_ = False

 def Initialize(self):
 # Initialize library
 error_code = Library.Initialize(sn, key)
 if error_code != e_ErrSuccess:
 return False
 self.is_initialize_ = True
 return True
 def Release(self):
 if self.is_initialize_:
 Library.Release()

def GetAllLayerNodesInformation(layer_node, depth):
 if depth >= 0:
 if layer_node.HasLayer():
 state = layer_node.GetViewUsage()
 depth += 1
 count = layer_node.GetChildrenCount()
 for i in range(0, count):
 child = layer_node.GetChild(i)
 GetAllLayerNodesInformation(child, depth, text_doc)

def main():
 err_ret = 0

 try:
 # Edit layer tree
 doc = PDFDoc("AboutFoxit.pdf")
 error_code = doc.Load("")
 layertree = LayerTree(doc)
 root = layertree.GetRootNode()
 children_count = root.GetChildrenCount()
 root.RemoveChild(children_count - 1)
 child = root.GetChild(children_count - 2)
 child0 = root.GetChild(0)
 child.MoveTo(child0, 0)
 child.AddChild(0, "AddedLayerNode", True)
 child.AddChild(0, "AddedNode", False)
 file_info = output_directory + "edit_layer_informations.txt"
 edit_info = TextDoc(file_info, "w+b")
 GetAllLayerNodesInformation(root, -1, edit_info)
 output_file = output_directory + "edit_layer_tree.pdf"
 doc.SaveAs(output_file)

 except Exception as ex:
 print(ex.GetMessage())
 err_ret = 1

 return err_ret

if __name__ == '__main__':
 libmgr = SDKLibMgr()
 if libmgr.Initialize():
 main()

 libmgr.Release()
```

How to use Foxit PDF SDK to do encryption and decryption for a PDF file by using Foxit DRM security method

```python
import os
import sys
import site

if sys.version_info.major == 2:
 _PYTHON2_ = True
else:
 _PYTHON2_ = False

if _PYTHON2_:
 site.addsitedir('../../../')
 from FoxitPDFSDKPython2 import *
else:
 from FoxitPDFSDKPython3 import *

sn = ""
key = ""

class SDKLibMgr:

 def __init__(self):
 self.is_initialize_ = False

 def Initialize(self):
 # Initialize library
 error_code = Library.Initialize(sn, key)
 if error_code != e_ErrSuccess:
 print("Library Initialize Error: {}".format(error_code))
 return False
 self.is_initialize_ = True
 return True

 def Release(self):
 if self.is_initialize_:
 Library.Release()

class DRMSecurityEvent(DRMSecurityCallback):

 def __init__(self, *args):
 if _PYTHON2_:
 super(DRMSecurityEvent, self).__init__()
 else:
 super().__init__()

 if (len(args) != 2):
 raise ValueError("args number error")

 self.file_id_ = args[0]
 self.initialize_key_ = args[1]

 def __del__(self):
 self.__disown__()

 def IsOwner(self, *args):
 return True

 def Release(self, *args):
 pass

 def GetUserPermissions(self, *args):
 return 0xFFFFFFFC

 def GetCipherType(self, *args):
 return SecurityHandler.e_CipherAES

 def GetKeyLength(doc, *args):
 return 16

 def GetFileID(self, *args):
 return self.file_id_

 def GetInitialKey(self, *args):
 return self.initialize_key_

def FoxitDRMDecrypt(input_file):
 try:

 doc = PDFDoc(input_file)
 error_code = doc.Load("")
 if error_code != e_ErrSuccess:
 return False

 # Do encryption.
 handler = DRMSecurityHandler()
 file_id = "Simple-DRM-file-ID"
 initialize_key = "Simple-DRM-initialize-key"
 encrypt_data = DRMEncryptData(True, "Simple-DRM-filter",
 SecurityHandler.e_CipherAES, 16, True,
 0xfffffffc)
 handler.Initialize(encrypt_data, file_id, initialize_key)
 doc.SetSecurityHandler(handler)

 output_file = "foxit_drm_encrypt.pdf"
 doc.SaveAs(output_file, PDFDoc.e_SaveFlagNoOriginal)

 # Do decryption.
 callback = DRMSecurityEvent(file_id, initialize_key)
 Library.RegisterSecurityCallback("FoxitDRM", callback)
 encrypted_doc = PDFDoc(output_file)
 error_code = encrypted_doc.Load("")
 if error_code != e_ErrSuccess:
 return False

 output_file = "foxit_drm_decrypt.pdf"
 encrypted_doc.RemoveSecurity()
 encrypted_doc.SaveAs(output_file, PDFDoc.e_SaveFlagNoOriginal)
 Library.UnregisterSecurityCallback("FoxitDRM")
 except Exception as ex:
 print(ex.GetMessage())
 return False

 return True

def main():
 err_ret = 0
 try:
 input_file = "AboutFoxit.pdf"
 FoxitDRMDecrypt(input_file)
 print("Security demo test.")
 except Exception as ex:
 print(ex.GetMessage())
 err_ret = 1

 return err_ret

if __name__ == '__main__':
 libmgr = SDKLibMgr()
 if libmgr.Initialize():
 main()

 libmgr.Release()
```

How to use Foxit PDF SDK to Convert a PDF file to a XML format file.

```python
import os
import sys
import site

if sys.version_info.major == 2:
 _PYTHON2_ = True
else:
 _PYTHON2_ = False

if _PYTHON2_:
 site.addsitedir('../../../')
 from FoxitPDFSDKPython2 import *
else:
 from FoxitPDFSDKPython3 import *

sn = ""
key = ""

class SDKLibMgr:
 def __init__(self):
 self.is_initialize_ = False

 def Initialize(self):
 # Initialize library
 error_code = Library.Initialize(sn, key)
 if error_code != e_ErrSuccess:
 print("Library Initialize Error: {}".format(error_code))
 return False
 self.is_initialize_ = True
 return True

 def Release(self):
 if self.is_initialize_:
 Library.Release()

def main():
 err_ret = 0

 ret = Convert.ToXML("AboutFoxit.pdf", "", "AboutFoxit.xml", "", True)
 if ret:
 print("Convert PDF file to XML format file successfully.")
 else:
 print("Convert PDF file to XML format file failed.")
 err_ret = 1

 return err_ret

if __name__ == '__main__':
 libmgr = SDKLibMgr()
 if libmgr.Initialize():
 main()
 libmgr.Release()

```

```python
def GetAllLayerNodesInformation(layer_node, depth):
 if depth >= 0:
 if layer_node.HasLayer():
 state = layer_node.GetViewUsage()
 depth += 1
 count = layer_node.GetChildrenCount()
 for i in range(0, count):
 child = layer_node.GetChild(i)
 GetAllLayerNodesInformation(child, depth, text_doc)

def main():

 try:
 # Create layer tree

 error_code = doc.Load("")
 has_layer = doc.HasLayer()
 layertree = LayerTree(doc)
 has_layer = doc.HasLayer()
 root = layertree.GetRootNode()
 xchild_count = root.GetChildrenCount()
 root.AddChild(0, "AddedLayerNode", True)
 root.AddChild(0, "AddedNode", False)
 file_info = output_directory + "create_layer_informations.txt"
 create_info = TextDoc(file_info, "w+b")
 GetAllLayerNodesInformation(root, -1, create_info)
```

How to use Foxit PDF SDK to do encryption and decryption for a PDF file by using Microsoft RMS security method.

```python
import os
import sys
import site

if sys.version_info.major == 2:
 _PYTHON2_ = True
else:
 _PYTHON2_ = False

if _PYTHON2_:
 site.addsitedir('../../../')
 from FoxitPDFSDKPython2 import *
else:
 from FoxitPDFSDKPython3 import *

sn = ""
key = ""

class SDKLibMgr:

 def __init__(self):
 self.is_initialize_ = False

 def Initialize(self):
 # Initialize library
 error_code = Library.Initialize(sn, key)
 if error_code != e_ErrSuccess:
 print("Library Initialize Error: {}".format(error_code))
 return False
 self.is_initialize_ = True
 return True

 def Release(self):
 if self.is_initialize_:
 Library.Release()

class RMSSecrutiyCallback(RMSSecurityCallback):

 def __init__(self, *args):
 if _PYTHON2_:
 super(RMSSecrutiyCallback, self).__init__()
 else:
 super().__init__()

 self.key_ = args[0]

 def __del__(self):
 self.__disown__()

 def Release(self, *args):
 pass

 def CreateContext(self, *args):
 return None

 def ReleaseContext(self, *args):
 return True

 def GetUserPermissions(self, *args):
 return 0xffffffc

 def IsOwner(self, *args):
 return True

 def GetCipher(self, *args):
 return SecurityHandler.e_CipherAES

 def GetEncryptKey(self, *args):
 return "key"

 def GetDecryptedSize(self, *args):
 data_size = args[1]
 return data_size

 def StartDecryptor(self, *args):
 return None

 def DecryptData(self, *args):
 data = args[1]
 if data is None:
 return ""
 enc_data_buf = data[0]
 enc_data_len = data[1]
 return enc_data_buf

 def FinishDecryptor(self, *args):
 return ""

 def GetEncryptedSize(self, *args):
 data = args[3]
 data_buf = data[0]
 data_lengh = data[1]
 return data_lengh

 def EncryptData(self, *args):
 data = args[3]
 src_buffer = data[0]
 src_length = data[1]
 return True, (src_buffer, src_length)

 def UseStandardCryptoMethod(self, *args):
 return False

def RMSSecurity(input_file):
 try:
 doc = PDFDoc(input_file)
 error_code = doc.Load("")
 if error_code != e_ErrSuccess:
 print("The Doc [{}] Error: {}\n".format(input_file, error_code))
 return False

 # Do encryption.
 callback = RMSSecrutiyCallback("Simple-RMS-encrpty-key")
 handler = RMSSecurityHandler()
 server_eul_list = StringArray()
 server_eul_list.Add("WM-1")
 server_eul_list.Add("This document has been encrypted by RMS encryption.")
 server_eul_list.Add("WM-2")
 server_eul_list.Add("Just for simple demo rms security.")
 encrypt_data = RMSEncryptData(True, "PubishLicense_0123",server_eul_list, 1)
 handler.Initialize(encrypt_data, callback)
 doc.SetSecurityHandler(handler)
 output_file = "rms_encrypt.pdf"
 doc.SaveAs(output_file, PDFDoc.e_SaveFlagNoOriginal)

 # Do decryption.
 Library.RegisterSecurityCallback("MicrosoftIRMServices", callback)
 encrypted_doc = PDFDoc(output_file)

 error_code = encrypted_doc.Load("")
 if error_code != e_ErrSuccess:
 return False

 output_file = "rms_decrypt.pdf"
 encrypted_doc.RemoveSecurity()
 encrypted_doc.SaveAs(output_file, PDFDoc.e_SaveFlagNoOriginal)
 Library.UnregisterSecurityCallback("Simple-RMS-encrpty-key")
 except Exception as ex:
 print(ex.GetMessage())
 return False

 return True

def main():
 err_ret = 0
 try:
 input_file = "AboutFoxit.pdf"
 RMSSecurity(input_file)
 print("Security demo test.")

 except Exception as ex:
 print(ex.GetMessage())
 err_ret = 1

 return err_ret

if __name__ == '__main__':
 libmgr = SDKLibMgr()
 if libmgr.Initialize():
 main()

 libmgr.Release()
```

How to use Foxit PDF SDK to verify if a PDF file is PDFA-1a version .

```python
import os
import sys
import site

if sys.version_info.major == 2:
 _PYTHON2_ = True
else:
 _PYTHON2_ = False

if _PYTHON2_:
 site.addsitedir('../../../')
 from FoxitPDFSDKPython2 import *
else:
 from FoxitPDFSDKPython3 import *

sn = ""
key = ""

class SDKLibMgr:
 def __init__(self):
 self.is_initialize_ = False
 def Initialize(self):
 # Initialize library
 error_code = Library.Initialize(sn, key)
 if error_code != e_ErrSuccess:
 return False
 self.is_initialize_ = True
 return True

 def Release(self):
 if self.is_initialize_:
 Library.Release()

class MyComplianceProgressCallback(ProgressCallback):
 def __init__(self, *args):
 if _PYTHON2_:
 super(MyComplianceProgressCallback, self).__init__()
 else:
 super().__init__()

 def __del__(self):
 self.__disown__()

 def Release(self):
 pass

 def UpdateCurrentStateData(self, *args):
 current_rate = args[0]
 current_state_string = args[1]
 print("Current rate:{}".format(current_rate))
 print("Current rate:{}, state str:".format(current_rate))
 print("\r\n")

def OutputPDFAHitData(result_info):
 hit_data_count = result_info.GetHitDataCount()
 print("== Hit Data, count:{:d} ==\r\n".format(hit_data_count))

 for i in range(0, hit_data_count):
 hit_data = result_info.GetHitData(i)
 print("Triggered count:{:d}\r\n".format(hit_data.triggered_count))
 print(hit_data.name)
 print(hit_data.comment)
 print("Trigger value:")
 trigger_value_count = hit_data.trigger_values.GetSize()
 if trigger_value_count < 1:
 print("\r\n")
 else:
 for z in range(0, trigger_value_count):
 print("\t")
 print(hit_data.trigger_values.GetAt(z))
 print("\r\n")

 print("Check severity:{:d}\r\nPage index:{:d}\r\n".format(hit_data.severity, hit_data.page_index))
 print("\r\n")

def main():
 err_ret = 0
 output_directory = output_path + "compliance/"
 input_file = "AboutFoxit.pdf"

 try:
 # If you use an authorization key for Foxit PDF SDK, please set a valid unlock code string to compliance_engine_unlockcode for ComplianceEngine.
 # If you use an trial key for Foxit PDF SDK, just keep compliance_engine_unlockcode as an empty string.
 compliance_resource_folder_path = ""
 compliance_engine_unlockcode = ""

 if compliance_resource_folder_path == "":
 return 1

 # Initialize compliance engine.
 error_code = ComplianceEngine.Initialize(compliance_resource_folder_path, compliance_engine_unlockcode)
 if error_code != e_ErrSuccess:
 return 1
 pdfa_compliance = PDFACompliance()

 verify_progress_callback = MyComplianceProgressCallback("0_pdfacompliance_verify_before_convert_progressdata.txt")
 verify_result_info = pdfa_compliance.Verify(PDFACompliance.e_VersionPDFA1a, input_file, 0, -1, verify_progress_callback)
 OutputPDFAHitData(verify_result_info)
 ComplianceEngine.Release()
 except Exception as ex:
 print(ex.GetMessage())
 err_ret = 1
 return err_ret

if __name__ == '__main__':
 libmgr = SDKLibMgr()
 if libmgr.Initialize():
 main()

 libmgr.Release()
```

how to transform bitmap
import os
import sys
import site
if sys.version_info.major == 2:
_PYTHON2_ = True
else:
_PYTHON2_ = False
if _PYTHON2_:
#replace with the python2 lib path
site.addsitedir(‘../../../’)
from FoxitPDFSDKPython2 import *
else:
from FoxitPDFSDKPython3 import *
sn = " "
key = " "

class SDKLibMgr:

 def __init__(self):
 self.is_initialize_ = False

 def Initialize(self):
 # Initialize library
 error_code = Library.Initialize(sn, key)

 self.is_initialize_ = True
 return True

 def Release(self):
 if self.is_initialize_:
 Library.Release()

def main():
 image = Image("Foxit.bmp")
 bitmap = image.GetFrameBitmap(0)

 width = bitmap.GetWidth()
 height = bitmap.GetHeight()

 # Stretch bitmap.
 stretch_bitmap = bitmap.StretchTo(int(width / 2), int(height * 2),
 Bitmap.e_Downsample, None)
 SaveBitmap(stretch_bitmap, "stetch_bitmap_Foxit.bmp")

 # Transform bitmap.
 left = 0
 top = 0
 transform_bitmap, left, top = bitmap.TransformTo(
 Matrix2D(width * 2.0, 0.0, 0.0, height / 2.0, 0.0, 0.0),
 Bitmap.e_Downsample, left, top, None)
 SaveBitmap(transform_bitmap, "transform_bitmap_Foxit.bmp")

 # Vertical and horizontal flip bitmap.
 flip_bitmap = bitmap.Flip(True, True)
 SaveBitmap(flip_bitmap, "flip_horz_vert_Foxit.bmp")

 # Swap the X and Y axis, and then vertical and horizontal flip bitmap.
 swap_xy_bitmap = bitmap.SwapXY(True, True, None)
 SaveBitmap(swap_xy_bitmap, "swap_xy_flip_horz_vert_Foxit.bmp")

 # Calculate the bounding box according to the given background color.
 rect = bitmap.CalculateBBoxByColor(0xFFFDFDFD)
 if rect.Height() > 0 and rect.Width() > 0:
 clone_bitmap = bitmap.Clone(rect)
 SaveBitmap(clone_bitmap, "calculate_bbox_by_color_0xFFFDFDFD_foxit.bmp")
 else:
 return 1；
 )

 # Detect the bounding box of content according to the given color difference between content and margin.
 rect = bitmap.DetectBBoxByColorDiffer(20, 64)
 if rect.Height() > 0 and rect.Width() > 0:
 clone_bitmap = bitmap.Clone(rect)
 SaveBitmap(clone_bitmap, "detect_bbox_by color_differ_20_64_Foxit.bmp")
 else:
 return 1；

if __name__ == '__main__':
 libmgr = SDKLibMgr()
 if libmgr.Initialize():
 main()

 libmgr.Release()

how to add freetext annotation with richtext as text box
import os
import sys
import time
import math
import site
import wave
from uuid import *

if sys.version_info.major == 2:
_PYTHON2_ = True
else:
_PYTHON2_ = False
if _PYTHON2_:
#replace with the python2 lib path
site.addsitedir(‘../../../’)
from FoxitPDFSDKPython2 import *
else:
from FoxitPDFSDKPython3 import *
sn = " "
key = " "

class SDKLibMgr:

 def __init__(self):
 self.is_initialize_ = False

 def Initialize(self):
 # Initialize library
 error_code = Library.Initialize(sn, key)

 self.is_initialize_ = True
 return True

 def Release(self):
 if self.is_initialize_:
 Library.Release()

def GetLocalDateTime():
 datetime = DateTime()
 localtime = time.localtime(time.time())
 datetime.year = localtime.tm_year
 datetime.month = localtime.tm_mon
 datetime.day = localtime.tm_mday
 datetime.hour = localtime.tm_hour
 datetime.minute = localtime.tm_min
 datetime.second = localtime.tm_sec

 offset = time.timezone if time.localtime().tm_isdst == 0 else time.altzone
 datetime.utc_hour_offset = int(offset / 60 / 60 * -1)
 datetime.utc_minute_offset = int((abs(offset) % 3600) / 60)

 return datetime

def AddAnnotations(page):
 # Add freetext annotation with richtext, as text box.
 freetext = FreeText(
 page.AddAnnot(Annot.e_FreeText, RectF(450, 50, 550, 100)))
 # This flag is used for printing annotations.
 freetext.SetFlags(4)
 # Set default appearance
 default_ap = DefaultAppearance()
 default_ap.flags = DefaultAppearance.e_FlagFont | DefaultAppearance.e_FlagFontSize | DefaultAppearance.e_FlagTextColor
 default_ap.font = Font(Font.e_StdIDHelveticaI)
 default_ap.text_size = 12.0
 default_ap.text_color = 0x000000
 # Set default appearance for form.
 freetext.SetDefaultAppearance(default_ap)
 freetext.SetContent("A text box annotation.")
 freetext.SetSubject("Textbox")
 freetext.SetTitle("Foxit SDK")
 freetext.SetCreationDateTime(GetLocalDateTime())
 freetext.SetModifiedDateTime(GetLocalDateTime())
 freetext.SetUniqueID(RandomUID())

 richtext_style = RichTextStyle()
 if sys.platform == "linux":
 richtext_style.font = Font("FreeSerif", 0, Font.e_CharsetANSI, 0)
 else:
 richtext_style.font = Font("Times New Roman", 0, Font.e_CharsetANSI, 0)

 richtext_style.text_color = 0xFF0000
 richtext_style.text_size = 10
 freetext.AddRichText("Textbox annotation ", richtext_style)

 richtext_style.text_color = 0x00FF00
 richtext_style.is_underline = True
 freetext.AddRichText("1-underline ", richtext_style)

 if sys.platform == "linux":
 richtext_style.font = Font("FreeSans", 0, Font.e_CharsetANSI, 0)
 else:
 richtext_style.font = Font("Calibri", 0, Font.e_CharsetANSI, 0)

 richtext_style.text_color = 0x0000FF
 richtext_style.is_underline = False
 richtext_style.is_strikethrough = True
 richtext_count = freetext.GetRichTextCount()
 freetext.InsertRichText(richtext_count - 1, "2_strikethrough ",
 richtext_style)

 # Appearance should be reset.
 freetext.ResetAppearanceStream()

def main():

 # Load a document
 doc = PDFDoc("annotation_input.pdf")
 error_code = doc.Load("")

 # Get first page with index 0
 page = doc.GetPage(0)
 AddAnnotations(page)

 # Save PDF file
 doc.SaveAs(newPdf, PDFDoc.e_SaveFlagNoOriginal)

if __name__ == '__main__':
 libmgr = SDKLibMgr()
 if libmgr.Initialize():
 main()

 libmgr.Release()

How to use Foxit PDF SDK to add, delete and modify the header-footer of PDF file.

```python
import os
import sys
import site

if sys.version_info.major == 2:
 _PYTHON2_ = True
else:
 _PYTHON2_ = False

if _PYTHON2_:
 site.addsitedir('../../../')
 from FoxitPDFSDKPython2 import *
else:
 from FoxitPDFSDKPython3 import *

sn = ""
key = ""
class SDKLibMgr:
 def __init__(self):
 self.is_initialize_ = False

 def Initialize(self):
 # Initialize library
 error_code = Library.Initialize(sn, key)
 if error_code != e_ErrSuccess:
 print("Library Initialize Error: {}".format(error_code))
 return False
 self.is_initialize_ = True
 return True

 def Release(self):
 if self.is_initialize_:
 Library.Release()

class TextDoc:
 def __init__(self, *args):
 if len(args) != 2:
 raise ValueError("Input expect two parameter numbers")

 self.file = open(args[0], args[1])

 def Write(self, *args):
 buf = args[0]
 if len(args) > 1:
 for i in range(0, args[0]):
 if _PYTHON2_:
 self.file.write(args[1])
 else:
 self.file.write(bytes(args[1], encoding="utf-8"))
 buf = args[2]

 if _PYTHON2_:
 self.file.write(buf)
 else:
 self.file.write(bytes(buf, encoding="utf-8"))
 self.file.flush()

def main():
 err_ret = 0

 if not os.path.exists(output_directory):
 os.makedirs(output_directory)

 try:

 input_file = "HeaderFooter.pdf"

 # Load PDF document.
 doc = PDFDoc(input_file)
 error_code = doc.Load("")
 if error_code != e_ErrSuccess:
 print("The Doc [{}] Error: {}\n".format(input_file, error_code))
 return 1

 headerfooter = doc.GetEditableHeaderFooter()
 # Update header-footer
 contentgenerator = HeaderFooterContentGenerator()
 contentgenerator.AddDate(
 HeaderFooterContentGenerator.e_DateFormatMSlashDSlashYYYY)
 contentgenerator.AddString(" foxit")
 content = headerfooter.content
 content.header_right_content = contentgenerator.GenerateContent()
 headerfooter.content = content
 doc.UpdateHeaderFooter(headerfooter)
 output_file = output_directory + "HeaderFooter_UpdateHeaderFooter.pdf"
 doc.SaveAs(output_file, PDFDoc.e_SaveFlagNoOriginal)
 print("Update PDF document header-footer.")

 # Add header-footer
 headerfooter.text_color = 0x00FFFF
 headerfooter.page_range = PageNumberRange(1, doc.GetPageCount(),Range.e_Odd)
 headerfooter.has_fixedsize_for_print = False
 headerfooter.has_text_shrinked = False
 headerfooter.start_page_number = 2
 headerfooter.page_margin = RectF(36, 70, 36, 70)
 headerfooter.text_size = 8
 doc.AddHeaderFooter(headerfooter)
 output_file = output_directory + "HeaderFooter_AddHeaderFooter.pdf"
 doc.SaveAs(output_file, PDFDoc.e_SaveFlagNoOriginal)
 print("Add PDF document header-footer.")

 # Remove all header-footers
 doc.RemoveAllHeaderFooters()
 output_file = "HeaderFooter_RemoveAll.pdf"
 doc.SaveAs(output_file, PDFDoc.e_SaveFlagNoOriginal)
 print("Remove PDF document all header-footers.")
 except Exception as ex:
 print(ex.GetMessage())
 err_ret = 1
 return err_ret

if __name__ == '__main__':
 libmgr = SDKLibMgr()
 if libmgr.Initialize():
 main()

 libmgr.Release()
```

How to use Foxit PDF SDK to extract text from PDF document.

```python
import os
import sys
import site

if sys.version_info.major == 2:
 _PYTHON2_ = True
else:
 _PYTHON2_ = False

if _PYTHON2_:
 site.addsitedir('../../../')
 from FoxitPDFSDKPython2 import *
else:
 from FoxitPDFSDKPython3 import *

sn = ""
key = ""

class SDKLibMgr:

 def __init__(self):
 self.is_initialize_ = False

 def Initialize(self):
 # Initialize library
 error_code = Library.Initialize(sn, key)
 if error_code != e_ErrSuccess:
 print("Library Initialize Error: {}".format(error_code))
 return False
 self.is_initialize_ = True
 return True

 def Release(self):
 if self.is_initialize_:
 Library.Release()

def main():
 err_ret = 0

 doc = PDFDoc("AboutFoxit.pdf")
 error_code = doc.Load("")
 if error_code != e_ErrSuccess:
 return

 file = open("AboutFoxit.txt", "wb+")

 pageCount = doc.GetPageCount()
 for i in range(pageCount):
 page = doc.GetPage(i)
 page.StartParse(PDFPage.e_ParsePageNormal, None, False)
 text_select = TextPage(page, TextPage.e_ParseTextNormal)
 count = text_select.GetCharCount()
 if (count > 0):
 chars = text_select.GetChars(0, count)
 if _PYTHON2_:
 file.write(chars)
 else:
 file.write(bytes(chars, encoding="utf-8"))

 file.close()
 print("Convert PDF file to TEXT file.")
 return err_ret

if __name__ == '__main__':
 libmgr = SDKLibMgr()
 if libmgr.Initialize():
 main()
 libmgr.Release()

```
