How to use Foxit PDF SDK to do output preview.

```python
import os
import sys
import site

if sys.version_info.major == 2:
 _PYTHON2_ = True
else:
 _PYTHON2_ = False

if _PYTHON2_:
 site.addsitedir('../../../')
 from FoxitPDFSDKPython2 import *
else:
 from FoxitPDFSDKPython3 import *

sn = ""
key = ""

class SDKLibMgr:
 def __init__(self):
 self.is_initialize_ = False

 def Initialize(self):
 # Initialize library
 error_code = Library.Initialize(sn, key)
 if error_code != e_ErrSuccess:
 print("Library Initialize Error: {}".format(error_code))
 return False
 self.is_initialize_ = True
 return True

 def Release(self):
 if self.is_initialize_:
 Library.Release()

def main():
 err_ret = 0
 input_file_path = "page_organization_123.pdf"

 # "default_icc_folder_path" is the path of the folder which contains default icc profile files. Please refer to Developer Guide for more details.
 default_icc_folder_path = ""
 if default_icc_folder_path == "":
 return 1

 # Set folder path which contains default icc profile files.
 try:
 Library.SetDefaultICCProfilesPath(default_icc_folder_path)
 except Exception as ex:
 print(ex.GetMessage())
 return 1

 try:
 pdf_doc = PDFDoc(input_file_path)
 pdf_doc.StartLoad("", True, None)
 pdf_page = pdf_doc.GetPage(0)
 pdf_page.StartParse(PDFPage.e_ParsePageNormal)
 page_width = pdf_page.GetWidth()
 page_height = pdf_page.GetHeight()
 bitmap_width = page_width
 bitmap_height = page_height
 bitmap_format = Bitmap.e_DIBInvalid
 background_color = 0x000000
 if pdf_page.HasTransparency():
 background_color = 0x000000
 bitmap_format = Bitmap.e_DIBArgb
 else:
 background_color = 0xFFFFFF
 bitmap_format = Bitmap.e_DIBRgb32

 display_matrix = pdf_page.GetDisplayMatrix(0, 0, int(bitmap_width),int(bitmap_height),e_Rotation0)
 render_bitmap = Bitmap(int(bitmap_width), int(bitmap_height),bitmap_format)
 render_bitmap.FillRect(background_color)
 renderer = Renderer(render_bitmap, False)

 output_preview = OutputPreview(pdf_doc)
 simulation_icc_file_path = input_path + "icc_profile/USWebCoatedSWOP.icc"
 output_preview.SetSimulationProfile(simulation_icc_file_path)
 output_preview.SetShowType(OutputPreview.e_ShowAll)
 process_plates = output_preview.GetPlates(OutputPreview.e_ColorantTypeProcess)
 spot_plates = output_preview.GetPlates(OutputPreview.e_ColorantTypeSpot)
 # Set check status of spot plate to be true, if there's any spot plate.
 for i in range(0, int(spot_plates.GetSize())):
 output_preview.SetCheckStatus(spot_plates[i].GetAt(i), True)
 # Only set one process plate to be checked each time and generate the preview bitmap.
 for i in range(0, int(process_plates.GetSize())):
 if 0 != i:
 output_preview.SetCheckStatus(process_plates.GetAt(i - 1),False)
 output_preview.SetCheckStatus(process_plates.GetAt(i), True)
 preview_bitmap = output_preview.GeneratePreviewBitmap(pdf_page, display_matrix, renderer)
 result_image = Image()
 result_image.AddFrame(preview_bitmap)
 temp_str = "preview_result_ProcessPlate[{}]_true.bmp".format(i)
 saved_file_path = output_directory + temp_str
 result_image.SaveAs(saved_file_path)
 print("[END] demo output_preview.")
 except Exception as ex:
 print(ex.GetMessage())
 err_ret = 1

 return err_ret

if __name__ == '__main__':
 libmgr = SDKLibMgr()
 if libmgr.Initialize():
 main()

 libmgr.Release()
```

How to use Foxit PDF SDK to verify and get PAdES level of a PAdES signature in PDF document.

```python
import os
import sys
import site
import time

if sys.version_info.major == 2:
 _PYTHON2_ = True
else:
 _PYTHON2_ = False

if _PYTHON2_:
 site.addsitedir('../../../')
 from FoxitPDFSDKPython2 import *
else:
 from FoxitPDFSDKPython3 import *

sn = ""
key = ""

TIMESTAMP_SIGNATURE_FILTER = "Adobe.PPKLite"
TIMESTAMP_SIGNATURE_SUBFILTER = "ETSI.RFC3161"
FREE_ETSIRFC316TSA_SERVER_NAME = "FreeTSAServer"
FREE_ETSIRFC316TSA_SERVER_URL = "http://ca.signfiles.com/TSAServer.aspx"

ETSICADES_SIGNATURE_FILTER = "Adobe.PPKLite"
ETSICADES_SIGNATURE_SUBFILTER = "ETSI.CAdES.detached"

class SDKLibMgr:

 def __init__(self):
 self.is_initialize_ = False

 def Initialize(self):
 # Initialize library
 error_code = Library.Initialize(sn, key)
 if error_code != e_ErrSuccess:
 print("Library Initialize Error: {}".format(error_code))
 return False
 self.is_initialize_ = True
 return True

 def Release(self):
 if self.is_initialize_:
 Library.Release()

def PAdESVerify(check_pdf_path, expect_pades_level):
 check_pdf_doc = PDFDoc(check_pdf_path)
 check_pdf_doc.StartLoad("", True, None)
 print("To verify level of PAdES signature in file {}\r\n".format(
 check_pdf_path))

 sig_count = check_pdf_doc.GetSignatureCount()
 if (0 == sig_count):
 print("No signature in current PDF file.\r\n")
 has_cades_signature = False
 for i in range(0, check_pdf_doc.GetSignatureCount()):
 temp_sig = check_pdf_doc.GetSignature(i)
 if temp_sig.IsEmpty(): continue
 sig_org_state = temp_sig.GetState()
 is_true = sig_org_state & Signature.e_StateSigned
 if not is_true: continue
 if temp_sig.GetSubFilter() == ETSICADES_SIGNATURE_SUBFILTER:
 has_cades_signature = True
 # Verify PAdES signature.
 verify_progressive = temp_sig.StartVerify()
 if (100 != verify_progressive.GetRateOfProgress()):
 if Progressive.e_Finished != verify_progressive.Continue():
 print(
 "[Failed] Fail to verify a PAdES signature. Signature index:{}\r\n"
 .format(i))
 continue

 sig_state = temp_sig.GetState()
 print(
 "Signature index: {}, a PAdES signature. State after verifying: {}\r\n"
 .format(i, TransformSignatureStateToString(sig_state)))

 # Get PAdES level.
 actual_level = temp_sig.GetPAdESLevel()
 print("Signature index:{}, {}\r\n".format(i, "matching expected level."
 if actual_level== expect_pades_level else "NOT match expected level."))

 if False == has_cades_signature:
 print("No PAdES signature in current PDF file.\r\n")

def main():
 err_ret = 0
 if not os.path.exists(output_directory):
 os.makedirs(output_directory)
 try:
 level = Signature.e_PAdESLevelBB
 PAdESVerify("example_LevelB.pdf", level)
 except Exception as ex:
 print(ex.GetMessage())
 err_ret = 1

 TimeStampServerMgr.Release()

 return err_ret

if __name__ == '__main__':
 libmgr = SDKLibMgr()
 if libmgr.Initialize():
 main()

 libmgr.Release()
```

How to use Foxit PDF SDK to do PKCS7 signature in PDF document.

```python
import os
import sys
import site

if sys.version_info.major == 2:
 _PYTHON2_ = True
else:
 _PYTHON2_ = False

if _PYTHON2_:
 site.addsitedir('../../../')
 from FoxitPDFSDKPython2 import *
else:
 from FoxitPDFSDKPython3 import *

sn = ""
key = ""

class SDKLibMgr:
 def __init__(self):
 self.is_initialize_ = False
 def Initialize(self):
 # Initialize library
 error_code = Library.Initialize(sn, key)
 if error_code != e_ErrSuccess:
 print("Library Initialize Error: {}".format(error_code))
 return False
 self.is_initialize_ = True
 return True

 def Release(self):
 if self.is_initialize_:
 Library.Release()

def PKCS7Signature(input_pdf_path, signed_pdf_path):
 pdf_doc = PDFDoc(input_pdf_path)
 pdf_doc.StartLoad("", True, None)
 pdf_page = pdf_doc.GetPage(0)
 page_width = pdf_page.GetWidth()
 page_height = pdf_page.GetHeight()
 new_sig_rect = RectF((page_width / 2 - 50.0), (page_height / 2 - 50.0),(page_width / 2 + 50.0), (page_height / 2 + 50.0))
 new_signature = pdf_page.AddSignature(new_sig_rect)
 new_signature.SetFilter(PKCS7_SIGNATURE_FILTER)
 new_signature.SetSubFilter(PKCS7_SIGNATURE_SUBFILTER)

 # String new_value
 new_signature.SetKeyValue(Signature.e_KeyNameSigner, "Foxit PDF SDK")
 new_signature.SetKeyValue(Signature.e_KeyNameContactInfo,
 "support@foxitsoftware.com")
 new_signature.SetKeyValue(Signature.e_KeyNameDN,
 "CN=CN,MAIL=MAIL@MAIL.COM")
 new_signature.SetKeyValue(Signature.e_KeyNameLocation, "Fuzhou, China")

 new_value = "As a sample for subfilter \"{}\" ".format(
 PKCS7_SIGNATURE_SUBFILTER)
 new_signature.SetKeyValue(Signature.e_KeyNameReason, new_value)
 new_signature.SetKeyValue(Signature.e_KeyNameText, new_value)
 sign_time = DateTime.GetLocalTime()
 new_signature.SetSignTime(sign_time)
 # Set appearance flags to decide which content would be used in appearance.
 ap_flags = Signature.e_APFlagLabel | Signature.e_APFlagSigner | \
 Signature.e_APFlagReason | Signature.e_APFlagDN | \
 Signature.e_APFlagLocation | Signature.e_APFlagText | \
 Signature.e_APFlagSigningTime
 new_signature.SetAppearanceFlags(ap_flags)

 cert_path = input_path + "foxit_all.pfx"
 cert_password = "123456"
 sign_progressive = new_signature.StartSign(cert_path, cert_password,
 Signature.e_DigestSHA256,
 signed_pdf_path)
 if sign_progressive.GetRateOfProgress() != 100:
 if Progressive.e_Finished != sign_progressive.Continue():
 print("[Failed] Fail to sign the new CAdES signature.\r\n")
 return

def main():
 err_ret = 0
 try:
 PKCS7Signature("AboutFoxit.pdf", "AboutFoxit_signed.pdf")
 except Exception as ex:
 print(ex.GetMessage())
 err_ret = 1
 return err_ret

if __name__ == '__main__':
 libmgr = SDKLibMgr()
 if libmgr.Initialize():
 main()
 libmgr.Release()
```

How to use Foxit PDF SDK to add bitmap watermarks into PDF files.

```python
import os
import sys
import site

if sys.version_info.major == 2:
 _PYTHON2_ = True
else:
 _PYTHON2_ = False

if _PYTHON2_:
 site.addsitedir('../../../')
 from FoxitPDFSDKPython2 import *
else:
 from FoxitPDFSDKPython3 import *

sn = ""
key = ""

class SDKLibMgr:
 def __init__(self):
 self.is_initialize_ = False

 def Initialize(self):
 # Initialize library
 error_code = Library.Initialize(sn, key)
 if error_code != e_ErrSuccess:
 return False
 self.is_initialize_ = True
 return True

 def Release(self):
 if self.is_initialize_:
 Library.Release()

def AddBitmapWatermark(doc, page, bitmap_file):
 settings = WatermarkSettings()
 settings.flags = WatermarkSettings.e_FlagASPageContents | WatermarkSettings.e_FlagOnTop
 settings.offset_x = 0.0
 settings.offset_y = 0.0
 settings.opacity = 60
 settings.position = e_PosCenterLeft
 settings.rotation = 90.0

 image = Image(bitmap_file)
 bitmap = image.GetFrameBitmap(0)
 settings.scale_x = page.GetHeight() * 1.0 / bitmap.GetWidth()
 settings.scale_y = settings.scale_x
 watermark = Watermark(doc, bitmap, settings)
 watermark.InsertToPage(page)

def AddSingleWatermark(doc, page):
 settings = WatermarkSettings()
 settings.flags = WatermarkSettings.e_FlagASPageContents | WatermarkSettings.e_FlagOnTop
 settings.offset_x = 0.0
 settings.offset_y = 0.0
 settings.opacity = 90
 settings.position = e_PosBottomRight
 settings.rotation = 0.0
 settings.scale_x = 0.1
 settings.scale_y = 0.1

 watermark = Watermark(doc, page, settings)
 watermark.InsertToPage(page)

def main():
 err_ret = 0

 if not os.path.exists(output_directory):
 os.makedirs(output_directory)

 try:

 input_file = "AboutFoxit.pdf"
 output_file = "watermark_add.pdf"

 doc = PDFDoc(input_file)
 error_code = doc.Load("")
 if error_code != e_ErrSuccess:
 print("The Doc [{}] Error: {}\n".format(input_file, error_code))
 return 1

 page_count = doc.GetPageCount()
 for i in range(0, page_count):
 page = doc.GetPage(i)
 page.StartParse(PDFPage.e_ParsePageNormal, None, False)
 wm_bmp = input_path + "watermark.bmp"
 AddBitmapWatermark(doc, page, wm_bmp)
 doc.SaveAs(output_file, PDFDoc.e_SaveFlagNoOriginal)
 print("Add watermarks to PDF file.")
 except Exception as ex:
 print(ex.GetMessage())
 err_ret = 1

 return err_ret

if __name__ == '__main__':
 libmgr = SDKLibMgr()
 if libmgr.Initialize():
 main()

 libmgr.Release()
```

How to use Foxit PDF SDK to operate PDF objects directly

```python
import os
import sys
import site

if sys.version_info.major == 2:
 _PYTHON2_ = True
else:
 _PYTHON2_ = False

if _PYTHON2_:
 site.addsitedir('../../../')
 from FoxitPDFSDKPython2 import *
else:
 from FoxitPDFSDKPython3 import *

sn = ""
key = ""

class SDKLibMgr:
 def __init__(self):
 self.is_initialize_ = False
 def Initialize(self):
 # Initialize library
 error_code = Library.Initialize(sn, key)
 if error_code != e_ErrSuccess:
 print("Library Initialize Error: {}".format(error_code))
 return False
 self.is_initialize_ = True
 return True
 def Release(self):
 if self.is_initialize_:
 Library.Release()

# This function is to do some operation to PDF object.
def ObjectOperation(document):
 boolean_object = PDFObject.CreateFromBoolean(True)
 boolean_object_number = document.AddIndirectObject(boolean_object)
 boolean_object_value = boolean_object.GetBoolean()
 float_object = PDFObject.CreateFromFloat(0.1)
 float_object_number = document.AddIndirectObject(float_object)
 float_object_value = float_object.GetFloat()
 integer_object = PDFObject.CreateFromInteger(1)
 integer_object_number = document.AddIndirectObject(integer_object)
 integer_object_value = integer_object.GetInteger()
 string_object = PDFObject.CreateFromString("foxit")
 string_object_number = document.AddIndirectObject(string_object)
 string_object_value = string_object.GetWideString()

 name_object = PDFObject.CreateFromName("sdk")
 name_object_number = document.AddIndirectObject(name_object)
 name_object_value = name_object.GetName()

 date_time = DateTime(2017, 9, 27, 19, 36, 6, 0, 8, 0)
 datetime_object = PDFObject.CreateFromDateTime(date_time)
 datetime_object_number = document.AddIndirectObject(datetime_object)
 datetime_object_value = datetime_object.GetWideString()
 array = PDFArray.Create()
 boolean_object_reference = PDFObject.CreateReference(
 document, boolean_object_number)
 boolean_object_reference_number = boolean_object_reference.GetObjNum()
 float_object_reference = PDFObject.CreateReference(document,
 float_object_number)
 integer_object_reference = PDFObject.CreateReference(
 document, integer_object_number)
 integer_object_direct = integer_object_reference.GetDirectObject()
 string_object_reference = PDFObject.CreateReference(
 document, string_object_number)
 name_object_reference = PDFObject.CreateReference(document,
 name_object_number)
 datetime_object_reference = PDFObject.CreateReference(
 document, datetime_object_number)

 array.AddElement(boolean_object_reference)
 array.AddElement(float_object_reference)
 array.AddElement(integer_object_reference)
 array.AddElement(string_object_reference)
 array.AddElement(name_object_reference)
 array.AddElement(datetime_object_reference)
 array.AddElement(boolean_object.CloneObject())
 array_object_number = document.AddIndirectObject(array)

# This function is to remove some properties from catalog dictionary.
def RemoveCatalogKey(document):
 if document.IsEmpty(): return
 catalog = document.GetCatalog()
 if catalog is None: return
 key_strings = ("Type", "Boolean", "Name", "String", "Array", "Dict")
 for i in range(0, len(key_strings)):
 if catalog.HasKey(key_strings[i]):
 catalog.RemoveAt(key_strings[i])

def main():
 err_ret = 0
 try:
 doc = PDFDoc("pdfobjects.pdf")
 doc.StartLoad("", False, None)

 # Do some operation about PDF object.
 ObjectOperation(doc)
 save_pdf_patth = "pdfobjects_addnewobjects.pdf"
 doc.StartSaveAs(save_pdf_patth, PDFDoc.e_SaveFlagNoOriginal, None)
 # To remove some properties from catalog dictionary.
 RemoveCatalogKey(doc)
 save_pdf_patth = "pdfobjects_removekeyfromcatalog.pdf"
 doc.StartSaveAs(save_pdf_patth, PDFDoc.e_SaveFlagNoOriginal, None)
 except Exception as ex:
 print(ex.GetMessage())
 err_ret = 1
 return err_ret

if __name__ == '__main__':
 libmgr = SDKLibMgr()
 if libmgr.Initialize():
 main()

 libmgr.Release()
```

How to use Foxit PDF SDK to open a wrapper PDF document.

```python
import os
import sys
import site

if sys.version_info.major == 2:
 _PYTHON2_ = True
else:
 _PYTHON2_ = False

if _PYTHON2_:
 site.addsitedir('../../../')
 from FoxitPDFSDKPython2 import *
else:
 from FoxitPDFSDKPython3 import *

sn = ""
key = ""

class SDKLibMgr:
 def __init__(self):
 self.is_initialize_ = False
 def Initialize(self):
 # Initialize library
 error_code = Library.Initialize(sn, key)
 if error_code != e_ErrSuccess:
 return False
 self.is_initialize_ = True
 return True

 def Release(self):
 if self.is_initialize_:
 Library.Release()

class FileReader(FileReaderCallback):

 def __init__(self, *args):
 if _PYTHON2_:
 super(FileReader, self).__init__()
 else:
 super().__init__()

 self.file_ = None
 self.filesize_ = args[0]

 def __del__(self):
 self.__disown__()

 def Release(self, *args):
 if self.file_ is not None:
 self.file_.close()

 def LoadFile(self, *args):
 self.file_ = open(args[0], "rb")
 if self.file_ is not None:
 return True
 else:
 return Fals
 def GetSize(self, *args):
 return self.filesize_

 def ReadBlock(self, *args):
 if self.file_ is None:
 return False, None
 size = 0
 if len(args) == 2:
 self.file_.seek(args[0], 0)
 size = args[1]
 elif len(args) == 1:
 size = args[0]
 else:
 return False, None

 buffer = self.file_.read(size)

 return True, buffer

class FileWriter(FileWriterCallback):

 def __init__(self, *args):
 if _PYTHON2_:
 super(FileWriter, self).__init__()
 else:
 super().__init__()

 self.file_ = None

 def __del__(self):
 self.__disown__()

 def Release(self, *args):
 self.file_.close()

 def LoadFile(self, *args):
 self.file_ = open(args[0], "wb")
 if self.file_ is not None:
 return True
 else:
 return False

 def GetSize(self, *args):
 self.file_.seek(0, os.SEEK_END)
 file_size = self.file_.tell()
 return file_size

 def Flush(self, *args):
 self.file_.flush()
 return True

 def WriteBlock(self, *args):
 if self.file_ is None:
 return False
 if(args[0] is not None):
 self.file_.seek(args[0][1], os.SEEK_SET)
 self.file_.write(args[0][0])
 return TRUE
 else:
 return False

def OpenWrapperFile(file_name):
 doc = PDFDoc(file_name)
 code = doc.Load("")
 if code != e_ErrSuccess:
 return False

 if not doc.IsWrapper():
 return False
 offset = doc.GetWrapperOffset()
 wrapper_data = doc.GetWrapperData()
 #"offset" can also indicate the end position of the document or the document size
 file_reader = FileReader(offset)
 file_reader.LoadFile(file_name)
 doc_real = PDFDoc(file_reader)
 code = doc_real.Load("")
 if code != e_ErrSuccess:
 return False
 return True

def main():
 err_ret = 0
 try:
 input_file = "wrapper.pdf"
 # Open the wrapper file.
 if not OpenWrapperFile(input_file):
 return 1
 except Exception as ex:
 print(ex.GetMessage())
 err_ret = 1

 return err_ret

if __name__ == '__main__':
 libmgr = SDKLibMgr()
 if libmgr.Initialize():
 main()

 libmgr.Release()
```

how to add square annotation by lower level api
import os
import sys
import time
import math
import site
import wave
from uuid import *

if sys.version_info.major == 2:
_PYTHON2_ = True
else:
_PYTHON2_ = False
if _PYTHON2_:
#replace with the python2 lib path
site.addsitedir(‘../../../’)
from FoxitPDFSDKPython2 import *
else:
from FoxitPDFSDKPython3 import *
sn = " "
key = " "

class SDKLibMgr:

 def __init__(self):
 self.is_initialize_ = False

 def Initialize(self):
 # Initialize library
 error_code = Library.Initialize(sn, key)

 self.is_initialize_ = True
 return True

 def Release(self):
 if self.is_initialize_:
 Library.Release()

def GetSoundAnnot(input_pdf_path, page_index):

 doc = PDFDoc(input_pdf_path)
 doc.Load("")
 pdf_page = doc.GetPage(page_index)
 if pdf_page.IsEmpty():
 return None

 annot_index_with_type = 0
 annot_index_with_all = 0
 annot = GetAnnotWithType(pdf_page, Annot.e_Sound, annot_index_with_type,
 annot_index_with_all)
 if annot.IsEmpty():
 return None

 if annot.GetType() != Annot.e_Sound:
 return None

 return Sound(annot)

def SaveSoundToFile(sound, file_path):
 if (sound.IsEmpty()):
 return False

 file = wave.open(file_path, 'wb')

 if file is None:
 return False

 sound_stream = sound.GetSoundStream()
 stream_size = sound_stream.GetDataSize(False)
 ret, data = sound_stream.GetData(False, stream_size)

 channel_count = sound.GetChannelCount()
 # set the number of channels.
 file.setnchannels(channel_count)

 # set the frame rate
 rate = int(sound.GetSamplingRate())
 file.setframerate(rate)
 # set the sample width to n bytes.
 file.setsampwidth(2)

 # write file data:
 encoding_format = sound.GetSampleEncodingFormat()
 if encoding_format == Sound.e_SampleEncodingFormatSigned:
 buffer = b''
 j = 0
 for i in range(0, stream_size, 2):
 low = data[j:j + 1]
 j += 1

 if j == stream_size:
 high = b'0'
 else:
 high = data[j:j + 1]
 j += 1

 buffer += high
 buffer += low
 file.writeframesraw(buffer)
 elif encoding_format == Sound.e_SampleEncodingFormatALaw or encoding_format == Sound.e_SampleEncodingFormatMuLaw:
 pass
 elif encoding_format == Sound.e_SampleEncodingFormatRaw:
 file.writeframesraw(data)
 else:
 file.writeframesraw(data)

 file.close()
 return TRUE

def main():
 output_sound_file = "sound.wav"
 input_sound_pdf_file = "sound.pdf"
 sound = GetSoundAnnot(input_sound_pdf_file, 0)
 SaveSoundToFile(sound, output_sound_file):

if __name__ == '__main__':
 libmgr = SDKLibMgr()
 if libmgr.Initialize():
 main()

 libmgr.Release()

How to use Foxit PDF SDK to recognize form in a PDF document.

```python
import os

import site
import time

 _PYTHON2_ = True
else:
 _PYTHON2_ = False

 site.addsitedir('../../../')
 from FoxitPDFSDKPython2 import *
else:
 from FoxitPDFSDKPython3 import *

key = ""

 def __init__(self):
 self.is_initialize_ = False

 def Initialize(self):
 # Initialize library
 error_code = Library.Initialize(sn, key)

 return False
 self.is_initialize_ = True
 return True

 if self.is_initialize_:
 Library.Release()

def main():
 err_ret = 0

 try:
 doc = PDFDoc("ElectricTable.pdf")
 doc.Load("")
 form = Form(doc)
 count = form.GetFieldCount();
 print("Field count:{}".format(count));
 print("===Start Recognize Form===");
 # Start to recognize form in current PDF document.
 doc.StartRecognizeForm(None);
 print("===End===");
 count = form.GetFieldCount();
 print("Field count:{}".format(count));
 for i in range(0, count):
 field = form.GetField(i);
 value = "NO."+str(i+1)
 field.SetValue(value);
 doc.SaveAs("ElectricTable_StartRecognizeForm.pdf", PDFDoc.e_SaveFlagNoOriginal)

 except Exception as ex:

 err_ret = 1

 return err_ret
```

how to add typewriter freetext annotation
import os
import sys
import time
import math
import site
import wave
from uuid import *

if sys.version_info.major == 2:
_PYTHON2_ = True
else:
_PYTHON2_ = False
if _PYTHON2_:
#replace with the python2 lib path
site.addsitedir(‘../../../’)
from FoxitPDFSDKPython2 import *
else:
from FoxitPDFSDKPython3 import *
sn = " "
key = " "

class SDKLibMgr:

 def __init__(self):
 self.is_initialize_ = False

 def Initialize(self):
 # Initialize library
 error_code = Library.Initialize(sn, key)

 self.is_initialize_ = True
 return True

 def Release(self):
 if self.is_initialize_:
 Library.Release()

def GetLocalDateTime():
 datetime = DateTime()
 localtime = time.localtime(time.time())
 datetime.year = localtime.tm_year
 datetime.month = localtime.tm_mon
 datetime.day = localtime.tm_mday
 datetime.hour = localtime.tm_hour
 datetime.minute = localtime.tm_min
 datetime.second = localtime.tm_sec

 offset = time.timezone if time.localtime().tm_isdst == 0 else time.altzone
 datetime.utc_hour_offset = int(offset / 60 / 60 * -1)
 datetime.utc_minute_offset = int((abs(offset) % 3600) / 60)

 return datetime

def AddAnnotations(page):
 # Add freetext annotation, as type writer.
 freetext = FreeText(page.AddAnnot(Annot.e_FreeText, RectF(10, 550, 200, 600)))
 # This flag is used for printing annotations.
 freetext.SetFlags(4)
 # Set default appearance
 default_ap = DefaultAppearance()
 default_ap.flags = DefaultAppearance.e_FlagFont | DefaultAppearance.e_FlagFontSize | DefaultAppearance.e_FlagTextColor
 default_ap.font = Font(Font.e_StdIDHelvetica)
 default_ap.text_size = 12.0
 default_ap.text_color = 0x000000
 # # Set default appearance for form.
 freetext.SetDefaultAppearance(default_ap)
 freetext.SetIntent("FreeTextTypewriter")
 freetext.SetContent("A typewriter annotation")
 freetext.SetSubject("FreeTextTypewriter")
 freetext.SetTitle("Foxit SDK")
 freetext.SetCreationDateTime(GetLocalDateTime())
 freetext.SetModifiedDateTime(GetLocalDateTime())
 freetext.SetUniqueID(RandomUID())
 # Appearance should be reset.
 freetext.ResetAppearanceStream()
 print("Add a typewriter freetext annotation.")

def main():

 # Load a document
 doc = PDFDoc("annotation_input.pdf")
 error_code = doc.Load("")

 # Get first page with index 0
 page = doc.GetPage(0)
 AddAnnotations(page)

 # Save PDF file
 doc.SaveAs(newPdf, PDFDoc.e_SaveFlagNoOriginal)

if __name__ == '__main__':
 libmgr = SDKLibMgr()
 if libmgr.Initialize():
 main()

 libmgr.Release()

How to use Foxit PDF SDK to implement importing and exporting of annotations in PDF documents, including importing fdf from files and memory buffers, and exporting to FDF and XFDF files.

```python
import os
import sys
import site

if sys.version_info.major == 2:
 _PYTHON2_ = True
else:
 _PYTHON2_ = False

if _PYTHON2_:
 site.addsitedir('../../../')
 from FoxitPDFSDKPython2 import *
else:
 from FoxitPDFSDKPython3 import *

sn = ""
key = ""

class SDKLibMgr:
 def __init__(self):
 self.is_initialize_ = False

 def Initialize(self):
 # Initialize library
 error_code = Library.Initialize(sn, key)
 if error_code != e_ErrSuccess:
 return False
 self.is_initialize_ = True
 return True
 def Release(self):
 if self.is_initialize_:
 Library.Release()

def main():
 err_ret = 0

 try:
 pdf_doc = PDFDoc("AboutFoxit.pdf")
 error_code = pdf_doc.Load("")
 if error_code != e_ErrSuccess:
 print("The PDFDoc {} Error: {}".format(input_file, error_code))
 return 1

 fdf_doc = FDFDoc(fdf_file)
 pdf_doc.ImportFromFDF(fdf_doc, PDFDoc.e_Annots)
 print("Import annotations from fdf with file.")
 output_file = output_directory + "AboutFoxit_importFDF.pdf"
 pdf_doc.SaveAs("AnnotationData.fdf", PDFDoc.e_SaveFlagNoOriginal)

 # Import FDF file
 pdf_doc = PDFDoc("AboutFoxit.pdf")
 error_code = pdf_doc.Load("")
 if error_code != e_ErrSuccess:
 print("The Doc [{}] Error: {}\n".format(input_file, error_code))
 return 1
 file = open("AnnotationData.fdf", "rb+")
 file.seek(0, os.SEEK_END)
 file_size = file.tell()
 file.seek(0, os.SEEK_SET)
 buffer = file.read(file_size)
 file.close()
 fdf_doc = FDFDoc(buffer, file_size)
 pdf_doc.ImportFromFDF(fdf_doc, PDFDoc.e_Annots)
 print("Import annotations from fdf with memory buffer.")
 pdf_doc.SaveAs("AboutFoxit_importFDF_FromMemory.pdf", PDFDoc.e_SaveFlagNoOriginal)

 # Export FDF file
 pdf_doc = PDFDoc("AnnotationDataExport.pdf")
 error_code = pdf_doc.Load("")
 if error_code != e_ErrSuccess:
 return 1

 fdf_doc = FDFDoc(FDFDoc.e_FDF)
 pdf_doc.ExportToFDF(fdf_doc, PDFDoc.e_Annots)

 fdf_doc.SaveAs("AnnotationDataExport_fdf.fdf")

 # Export XFDF file
 input_file = ""
 output_xfdf = ""
 pdf_doc = PDFDoc("AnnotationDataExport.pdf")
 error_code = pdf_doc.Load("")
 if error_code != e_ErrSuccess:
 return 1
 fdf_doc = FDFDoc(FDFDoc.e_XFDF)
 pdf_doc.ExportToFDF(fdf_doc, PDFDoc.e_Annots)
 fdf_doc.SaveAs("AnnotationDataExport_xfdf.xfdf")
 except Exception as ex:
 print(ex.GetMessage())
 err_ret = 1

 return err_ret

if __name__ == '__main__':
 libmgr = SDKLibMgr()
 if libmgr.Initialize():
 main()

 libmgr.Release()

```

How to use Foxit PDF SDK to creat a pressure sensitive ink and convert it to annotation.

```python
import os
import sys
import site

if sys.version_info.major == 2:
 _PYTHON2_ = True
else:
 _PYTHON2_ = False

if _PYTHON2_:
 site.addsitedir('../../../')
 from FoxitPDFSDKPython2 import *
else:
 from FoxitPDFSDKPython3 import *

sn = ""
key = ""

output_path = "../output_files/"
input_path = "../input_files/"
output_directory = output_path + "psi/"

kPointsData = (
 1, 121.3043, 326.6846, 0.0966, 2, 121.1304, 326.8709, 0.1376, 2, 121.1304, 326.9641, 0.1484,
 2, 121.1304, 327.0572, 0.2226, 2, 121.1304, 327.2435, 0.3203, 2, 121.1304, 327.5230, 0.3916,
 2, 121.4782, 330.7833, 0.7041, 2, 122.0000, 331.4354f, 0.7275, 2, 122.9565, 331.9943, 0.7363,
 2, 546.0869, 402.0447, 0.5322, 3, 546.0869, 402.0447, 0.0000 );

class SDKLibMgr:
 def __init__(self):
 self.is_initialize_ = False

 def Initialize(self):
 # Initialize library
 error_code = Library.Initialize(sn, key)
 if error_code != e_ErrSuccess:
 print("Library Initialize Error: {}".format(error_code))
 return False
 self.is_initialize_ = True
 return True

 def Release(self):
 if self.is_initialize_:
 Library.Release()

def main():
 err_ret = 0
 try:
 psi = PSI(480, 180, True)
 # Set ink diameter.
 psi.SetDiameter(9)
 # Set ink color.
 psi.SetColor(0x434236)
 # Set ink opacity.
 psi.SetOpacity(0.8)
 # Add points to pressure sensitive ink.
 for i in range(0, len(kPointsData), 4):
 x = kPointsData[i + 1] - 100.0
 y = kPointsData[i + 2] - 300.0
 pressure = kPointsData[i + 3]
 type = int(kPointsData[i])
 psi.AddPoint(PointF(x, y), type, pressure)
 image = Image()
 image.AddFrame(psi.GetBitmap())
 output_file = output_directory + "pressure_sensitive_ink.bmp"
 image.SaveAs(output_file)
 doc = PDFDoc()
 page = doc.InsertPage(0)
 # Convert PSI to PSInk annotation.
 width = 480.0
 height = 180.0
 rect = RectF(page.GetWidth() / 2 - width / 2,
 page.GetHeight() / 2 - height / 2,
 page.GetWidth() / 2 + width / 2,
 page.GetHeight() / 2 + height / 2)
 annot = psi.ConvertToPDFAnnot(page, rect, e_Rotation0)

 output_file = output_directory + "pressure_sensitive_ink.pdf"
 doc.SaveAs(output_file, PDFDoc.e_SaveFlagNormal)
 print("PSI test.")

 except Exception as ex:
 print(ex.GetMessage())
 err_ret = 1

 return err_ret

if __name__ == '__main__':
 libmgr = SDKLibMgr()
 if libmgr.Initialize():
 main()

 libmgr.Release()
```

How to use Foxit PDF SDK to convert jpg files to PDF files.

```python
import os
import sys
import site

if sys.version_info.major == 2:
 _PYTHON2_ = True
else:
 _PYTHON2_ = False

if _PYTHON2_:
 site.addsitedir('../../../')
 from FoxitPDFSDKPython2 import *
else:
 from FoxitPDFSDKPython3 import *

sn = ""
key = ""

class SDKLibMgr:
 def __init__(self):
 self.is_initialize_ = False
 def Initialize(self):
 # Initialize library
 error_code = Library.Initialize(sn, key)
 if error_code != e_ErrSuccess:
 print("Library Initialize Error: {}".format(error_code))
 return False
 self.is_initialize_ = True
 return True
 def Release(self):
 if self.is_initialize_:
 Library.Release()

def Image2PDF(input_file, output_file):
 image = Image(input_file)
 count = 1
 if image.GetType() != Image.e_JBIG2:
 count = image.GetFrameCount()
 doc = PDFDoc()
 for i in range(0, count):
 page = doc.InsertPage(i, image.GetWidth(), image.GetHeight())
 page.StartParse(PDFPage.e_ParsePageNormal, None, False)
 # Add image to page
 page.AddImage(image, i, PointF(0, 0), image.GetWidth(),
 image.GetHeight(), True)
 doc.SaveAs(output_file, PDFDoc.e_SaveFlagNoOriginal)

def main():
 err_ret = 0

 try:
 # Convert .jpg file to PDF document by using insert image to page.
 Image2PDF("example.jpg", "example.pdf")
 except Exception as ex:
 print(ex.GetMessage())
 err_ret = 1
 try:
 # Convert .jpg file to PDF document by using Foxit PDF SDK Convert API.
 Convert.FromImage("example.jpg", "example.pdf")
 except Exception as ex:
 print(ex.GetMessage())
 err_ret = 1
 return err_ret

if __name__ == '__main__':
 libmgr = SDKLibMgr()
 if libmgr.Initialize():
 main()
 libmgr.Release()

```

how to manage bookmark
import os
import sys
import site
from uuid import *

if sys.version_info.major == 2:
_PYTHON2_ = True
else:
_PYTHON2_ = False
if _PYTHON2_:
#replace with the python2 lib path
site.addsitedir(‘../../../’)
from FoxitPDFSDKPython2 import *
else:
from FoxitPDFSDKPython3 import *
sn = " "
key = " "

class SDKLibMgr:

 def __init__(self):
 self.is_initialize_ = False

 def Initialize(self):
 # Initialize library
 error_code = Library.Initialize(sn, key)

 self.is_initialize_ = True
 return True

 def Release(self):
 if self.is_initialize_:
 Library.Release()

def ShowBookmarksInfo(doc, info_path):
 text_doc = TextDoc(info_path, "wb+")
 root = doc.GetRootBookmark()
 if not root.IsEmpty():
 ShowBookmarkInfo(root, text_doc, 0)
 else:
 text_doc.Write("No bookmark information!\r\n")

def main():
 doc = PDFDoc("AboutFoxit.pdf")
 error_code = doc.Load("")
 # Show original bookmark information.
 ShowBookmarksInfo(doc, "bookmark_info.txt")

 # Get bookmark root node or Create new bookmark root node.
 root = doc.GetRootBookmark()
 if root.IsEmpty():
 root = doc.CreateRootBookmark()

 for i in range(0, doc.GetPageCount(), 2):
 dest = Destination.CreateFitPage(doc, i)
 ws_title = "A bookmark to a page (index: {:d})".format(i)
 child = root.Insert(ws_title, Bookmark.e_PosLastChild)
 child.SetDestination(dest)
 child.SetColor(i * 0xF68C21)

 doc.SaveAs("bookmark_add.pdf", PDFDoc.e_SaveFlagNoOriginal)

 # Get first bookmark and change properties.
 first_bookmark = root.GetFirstChild()
 first_bookmark.SetStyle(Bookmark.e_StyleItalic)
 first_bookmark.SetColor(0xFF0000)
 first_bookmark.SetTitle("Change bookmark title, style, and color")

 # Remove next sibling bookmark
 if not first_bookmark.GetNextSibling().IsEmpty():
 doc.RemoveBookmark(first_bookmark.GetNextSibling())

 ShowBookmarksInfo(doc, "bookmark_info1.txt")

 doc.SaveAs("bookmark_change.pdf", PDFDoc.e_SaveFlagNoOriginal)
 print("Bookmark demo.")

if __name__ == '__main__':
 libmgr = SDKLibMgr()
 if libmgr.Initialize():
 main()

 libmgr.Release()

---

How to use Foxit PDF SDK to convert a PDF file to png files.

```python
import os
import sys
import site

if sys.version_info.major == 2:
 _PYTHON2_ = True
else:
 _PYTHON2_ = False

if _PYTHON2_:
 site.addsitedir('../../../')
 from FoxitPDFSDKPython2 import *
else:
 from FoxitPDFSDKPython3 import *

sn = ""
key = ""

class SDKLibMgr:

 def __init__(self):
 self.is_initialize_ = False

 def Initialize(self):
 # Initialize library
 error_code = Library.Initialize(sn, key)
 if error_code != e_ErrSuccess:
 return False
 self.is_initialize_ = True
 return True

 def Release(self):
 if self.is_initialize_:
 Library.Release()

def Save2Image(bitmap, page_index, sExt, from_memory):
 # Add the bitmap to image and save the image.
 image = Image()
 image.AddFrame(bitmap)
 s = ""
 if from_memory:
 s = "AboutFoxit_from_memory_{}".format(page_index)
 else:
 s = "AboutFoxit_{}".format(page_index)
 s = output_directory + s + sExt
 print(s)
 image.SaveAs(s)

def PDF2Bmp(doc, from_memory):
 # Get page count
 nPageCount = doc.GetPageCount()
 for i in range(0, nPageCount):
 page = doc.GetPage(i)
 # Parse page.
 page.StartParse(PDFPage.e_ParsePageNormal, None, False)
 width = int(page.GetWidth())
 height = int(page.GetHeight())
 matrix = page.GetDisplayMatrix(0, 0, width, height, page.GetRotation())
 # Prepare a bitmap for rendering.
 bitmap = Bitmap(width, height, Bitmap.e_DIBArgb)
 bitmap.FillRect(0xFFFFFFFF, None)
 # Render page
 render = Renderer(bitmap, False)
 render.StartRender(page, matrix, None)
 Save2Image(bitmap, i, ".png", from_memory)

def main():
 err_ret = 0
 try:
 doc = PDFDoc("AboutFoxit.pdf")
 error_code = doc.Load("")
 if error_code != e_ErrSuccess:
 return 1

 PDF2Bmp(doc, False)
 file = open(input_file, "rb+")
 buffer = file.read()
 doc_memory = PDFDoc(buffer, len(buffer))
 error_code = doc_memory.Load("")
 if error_code != e_ErrSuccess:
 return 1
 PDF2Bmp(doc_memory, True)
 except Exception as ex:
 print(ex.GetMessage())
 err_ret = 1

 return err_ret

if __name__ == '__main__':
 libmgr = SDKLibMgr()
 if libmgr.Initialize():
 main()

 libmgr.Release()
```

---

How to use the Foxit PDF SDK to convert DWG files to PDF files. It initializes the SDK, sets up conversion settings, and performs the conversion while handling exceptions.

```python
import os
import sys
import site

if sys.version_info.major == 2:
 _PYTHON2_ = True
else:
 _PYTHON2_ = False

if _PYTHON2_:
 site.addsitedir('../../../')
 from FoxitPDFSDKPython2 import *
else:
 from FoxitPDFSDKPython3 import *

sn = ""
key = ""

class SDKLibMgr:
 def __init__(self):
 self.is_initialize_ = False

 def Initialize(self):
 # Initialize library
 error_code = Library.Initialize(sn, key)
 if error_code != e_ErrSuccess:
 print("Library Initialize Error: {}".format(error_code))
 return False
 self.is_initialize_ = True
 return True

 def Release(self):
 if self.is_initialize_:
 Library.Release()

def main():
 err_ret = 0
 # "engine_path" is the path of the engine file "dwg2pdf" which is used to convert dwg to pdf. Please refer to Developer Guide for more details.
 engine_path = ""
 try:
 # Setting DWG2PDFSettingData values.
 settings = DWG2PDFSettingData()
 settings.export_flags = DWG2PDFSettingData.e_FlagZoomToExtentsMode
 settings.export_hatches_type = DWG2PDFSettingData.e_DWG2PDFExportHatchesTypeBitmap
 settings.other_export_hatches_type = DWG2PDFSettingData.e_DWG2PDFExportHatchesTypeBitmap
 settings.gradient_export_hatches_type = DWG2PDFSettingData.e_DWG2PDFExportHatchesTypeBitmap
 settings.searchable_text_type = DWG2PDFSettingData.e_DWG2PDFSearchableTextTypeNoSearch
 settings.is_active_layout = True
 settings.paper_width = 650
 settings.paper_height = 850
 settings.output_title = "DWG2PDF"
 settings.output_author = "Cad Artist"
 settings.output_subject = "Cad Subject"
 settings.output_keywords = "DWG2PDF"
 settings.output_creator = "Dwg Artist"
 settings.output_producer = "FoxitSDK"
 # Convert DWG file to PDF file.
 Convert.FromDWG(engine_path, "ParcelMap.dwg", "dwg2pdf_result.pdf", settings)
 print("Convert DWG to PDF successfully.")
 except Exception as ex:
 print(ex.GetMessage())
 err_ret = 1
 return err_ret

if __name__ == '__main__':
 libmgr = SDKLibMgr()
 if libmgr.Initialize():
 main()

 libmgr.Release()
```
